Is there a joining fee and Annual fee for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?
Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:
Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform https://teetimes.truztee.com/ with your registered mobile number.
Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.
Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

What are the movie ticket benefits available Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Cardholders are eligible for a Buy-One-Get-One movies, sport events, theatre or concert tickets offer worth up to ₹750 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please click here .
What are the key features of the concierge services offered?
The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).
What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?
The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards.
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?
Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please click here .
What is the age limit for the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
You must be between the age group of 21–65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.
How can I know the bill due date of my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can find the bill due date of your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card on your monthly statement, in the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care at 1800 1080.
Is it safe to transact with the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Yes. Since your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip for high-level security, you can transact safely & securely.
What are the key features of the Mastercard Privileges?
Mastercard Moments is an exclusive programme specially created for Mastercard cardholders. At the heart of this programme is a host of exceptional experiences designed to inspire and enrich the lives of our Mastercard cardholders, with programme members able to enjoy additional benefits.
For more details,  https://specials.priceless.com/en-in/homePage
How do I find the CVV on my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Flip your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your Card Verification Value (CVV). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

What is Times Black ICICI Bank credit card?
The Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card is an exclusive Credit Card issued by ICICI Bank in association with Times Internet Ltd. and Visa. Designed for Ultra-High Net Worth Individuals (UHNIs), this card offers premium benefits across various categories, including luxury stays, travel experiences, lifestyle and mobility.
How long are Milestone Benefits available to eligible cardholders?
Milestone Benefits can be accessed through the Times Black app for a period of six months, starting from the date the eligible cardholder is notified about the respective milestone by ICICI Bank.
How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge access?
Enjoy unlimited complimentary accesses to international airport lounges with Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?
For lounge visits within India, Primary and Add-on Cardholders can avail unlimited complimentary lounge access through Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card. Please swipe the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card to avail the complimentary lounge access. To view the complete list of lounges, click here .
How are ICICI Bank reward points earned? Are there any limits or exclusions?
You can earn 2% ICICI Bank reward points on all eligible domestic transactions. However, there is a cap of 5,000 reward points per statement cycle for the following categories:
Utility payments
Insurance premium payments
Education payments
Government payments (such as property tax, advance tax, fees, court payments, postal payments, etc.)
Additionally, ICICI Bank reward points will not be earned on fuel transactions, rent payments or transactions converted into EMIs. The points earned on such transactions will be reversed.
What is the value of 1 ICICI Bank reward point, and how can it be redeemed?
The value of 1 ICICI Bank reward point can be up to ₹ 1. However, when redeeming ICICI Bank reward points against your statement, the redemption rate is 1 Reward Point (RP) = ₹0.40.
Does the Times Black Credit Card offer any luxury Gift Card benefits?
Yes, as a Times Black Credit Card holder, you receive a TATA CLiQ Luxury Gift Card worth ₹10,000, which can be used to shop for premium luxury items and experiences.
What are the Times Black Credit Card benefits related to international experiences?
With the Times Black Credit Card, you can enjoy international experiences and benefits worth ₹10,000 on Klook, allowing you to explore exciting activities and attractions worldwide.
What luxury stay benefits does the Times Black Credit Card provide?
The Times Black Credit Card offers a one-night luxury stay at Ayatana or Lohono worth ₹20,000, providing an unforgettable getaway experience in a luxurious setting.
What are the charges applicable for the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Joining Fee: ₹ 20,000 + GST
Annual Fee: ₹ 20,000 + GST
How can I get the annual fee waiver?
You can get your annual fee waived from the 2nd year onwards on minimum spends of ₹25,00,000 made in the previous year.
When will I get my joining benefits for the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the joining fee.
How do I complete my video KYC verification?
You are required to provide your PAN Card and Aadhaar Card details followed by a video-based verification with an ICICI Bank employee. You will be required to accept a call request from the ICICI Bank employee and complete your video KYC by answering a few questions asked by them and showing the original PAN Card. Video KYC is available 24x7 on all days.
How will I get the PIN for my Credit Card?
You can generate the PIN in any of the following ways:
Using the iMobile app: Go to Services > Card PIN Services > Generate Credit Card PIN
Using Net Banking: Log into Net Banking > Generate Card PIN > Credit Card PIN > Select Card and enter CVV > Submit > Enter OTP > Enter PIN > Generate Now
Using the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system: Call Customer Care on 1800 1080 and follow the instructions.

What types of spending are excluded from milestone calculations?

Interest or service charges

What services are included in Roadside Assistance?

What is the towing benefit under Roadside Assistance?
If your vehicle is immobilised due to electrical or mechanical failure, accident or wrong fuelling, the service provider will arrange for your vehicle to be towed to the nearest authorised OEM workshop. The towing service ensures that your vehicle is safely handled and reaches the appropriate repair facility.
How does the Locked / Lost Key benefit work?
If you are locked out of your vehicle or your key is lost, the service provider will arrange for the retrieval of your spare key from your residence. This ensures that you can regain access to your vehicle without undue delay or hassle.
What is the procedure for using the Roadside Assistance service?

What is the Fuel Delivery benefit?

What happens if vehicle repairs exceed two days?
If vehicle repairs take more than two days, you can opt for vehicle repatriation to your hometown for up to 100 km, free of cost. For distances beyond 100 km, repatriation services are available on a chargeable basis, ensuring flexibility for long-term repairs.
What is the Replacement / Courtesy Car benefit?
If your vehicle is immobilised and you need local mobility, a replacement or courtesy car of a higher category or the best available vehicle will be arranged at prevailing market rates.
What emergency accommodation is offered?
If your vehicle is immobilised while traveling outstation, Roadside Assistance can help arrange emergency hotel accommodations or medical services near the breakdown location, ensuring your safety and comfort during unexpected incidents.

Central Travel Account Card FAQs
What is a Central Travel Account (CTA) Card?
The ICICI Bank CTA Card is a centralised corporate payment solution that allows businesses to manage all travel-related expenses through one account. Instead of issuing separate cards to each employee, the company can route bookings and payments centrally, ensuring better control, transparency, and simplified reconciliation.
Who can apply for a CTA Card?
The CTA Card is issued only to corporates and business entities that have regular travel and lodging requirements, subject to eligibility and documentation.
What are the key benefits of the CTA Card?
The card provides corporates with the convenience of making all payments through a single account, resulting in enhanced control over expenses. It helps in easier reconciliation through consolidated statements, supports integration with ERP systems and Travel Management Companies (TMCs). It is globally accepted at airlines, hotels and travel agencies, which makes it an ideal solution for managing both domestic and international travel expenses.
How is the CTA Card different from a Corporate Credit Card?
A Corporate Credit Card is issued to individual employees to meet their business travel and expense requirements, while a CTA Card is issued at the company level and is primarily used for centralised travel bookings. The CTA Card ensures that all travel spends are consolidated into one account, whereas Corporate Credit Cards are designed for distributed employee-level usage.
What kind of expenses can be paid using the CTA Card?
The CTA Card is designed exclusively for travel-related expenses. It can be used for airline tickets, hotel stays, payments to travel agencies and other lodging or transportation services, depending on the company’s agreement with the bank.
How does billing and repayment work?
All expenses incurred on the CTA Card are consolidated into a single monthly statement that the corporate is required to clear. This significantly reduces administrative work, and ICICI Bank also provides Enhanced Data through the Network that can be used for expense tracking and automated reconciliation across departments or projects.
What is the liability model for the CTA Card?
The liability for repayment lies entirely with the corporate entity. ICICI Bank enters into an agreement with the company that clearly defines repayment responsibilities and credit limits.
How can employee-wise or trip-wise spends be tracked?
ICICI Bank provides Enhanced Data by matching booking details from TMC and spend details of the card that allows corporates to tag expenses by employee ID, cost centre, project code or trip reference at the time of booking. This makes monitoring and allocation of costs simple and transparent.
Can international travel expenses be paid with the CTA Card?
Yes. The CTA Card can be used both for domestic and international travel. International usage will be subject to standard foreign exchange mark-ups and charges as per ICICI Bank’s policy, while ensuring seamless acceptance worldwide.
How can a company apply for the CTA Card?
A company can apply for the CTA Card by contacting its ICICI Bank Relationship Manager or visiting nearest branch. The process involves submitting required documents, undergoing a credit assessment and signing a corporate liability agreement.

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Interest Charge

Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee

GST

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

What is a Credit Card?

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

What is Credit Card balance?

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

What is a Credit Card?

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

What is Credit Card balance?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

How to apply for a Credit Card with ICICI Bank
Here are the steps to apply online for an ICICI Bank Credit Card:

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants

Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Fuel Credit Card FAQs
What are Fuel Credit Cards?
Fuel Credit Cards are specially designed Credit Cards that help customers save on everyday fuel expenses while enjoying the convenience of cashless payments. ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Cards offer benefits such as fuel surcharge waivers, cashback on fuel spends, ​​​​points and savings at partner fuel stations. Depending on the card variant, customers may also enjoy accelerated ​​​​rewards on everyday spending categories such as groceries and departmental stores along with ​​​​additional features such as roadside assistance, airport or railway lounge access and dining or entertainment benefit
What is a fuel surcharge waiver on a Credit Card? What are the other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card?
A fuel surcharge waiver is a Fuel Credit Card benefit from ICICI Bank, waiving off the additional fee or surcharge that is typically added to fuel purchases. You can avail this benefit if you have a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank. Other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card include cashback, reward points on fuel purchases and exclusive discounts on other utilities, making this fuel Credit Card an excellent choice for savings on fuel expenses.
Can I use a Fuel Credit Card at any fuel station?
You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank and use it at most fuel stations, but the best benefits are usually applicable only at specific partner outlets. Using the Card at pumps other than the partner pumps might not offer rewards or surcharge waivers, so read the terms and conditions carefully before applying for a Card or using it.
Are there Credit Cards specifically for diesel as fuel?
Cashback and Reward points on most Fuel Credit Cards apply to diesel purchases also. They also offer surcharge waivers on fuel spends, regardless of fuel type. However, always check the Card’s terms and partner fuel stations to reconfirm whether diesel purchases are eligible for benefits and rewards.
Is there an option to apply for an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card online?
You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch and a Bank representative will help you apply for a Credit Card. Keep your documents like proof of identity, proof of address and Income statements handy.
How can I use an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card for an in-store purchase?
To use your ICICI Bank Credit Card for an in-store purchase, just swipe or tap your card on the card machine and enter your Personal Identification Number (PIN).
How can I pay the bill for my ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card?
You can pay your ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card bill through Net Banking, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), by setting up the Auto Debit facility for your account or by visiting an ICICI Bank branch or an Automated Teller Machine (ATM).
How can I check my Credit Card details online?
To check your ICICI Bank Credit Card details, log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app. Here, you can view all the details related to your Credit Card.
What is a petroleum Credit Card?
A petroleum Credit Card is the same as a Fuel Credit Card. This Credit Card is designed to offer savings on fuel purchases. ICICI Bank’s Fuel Credit Cards provide cashback, reward points and fuel surcharge waivers when used at petrol pumps. These Cards partner with fuel companies and are perfect for daily commuters looking to reduce monthly fuel costs while earning rewards.
What are the key features of a fuel Credit Card?
Fuel Credit Cards offer fuel-related savings and convenient payment features designed around everyday fuel purchases. Depending on the card variant, cardholders can enjoy cashback on fuel spends at HPCL fuel stations, fuel surcharge waivers and additional savings through partner payment platforms.

Applicants may also be required to submit documents such as identity proof, address proof and income proof during the application process. Card approval and issuance are subject to ICICI Bank’s internal policies and verification.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Platinum Chip Credit Card FAQs
Is there a joining fee or annual fee for Platinum Chip Credit Card?
The Platinum Chip Credit Card has no joining fee or annual fee.
What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it on my ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card?
Flip your Platinum Chip Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.
Which bank’s Credit Card should I opt for?
The ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card is an excellent choice. It has no joining fee or annual fee.
What is the age limit to apply for a Platinum Chip Credit Card?
You must be between the ages of 21-65 years to be eligible to apply for an ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card.
How to know the payment due date of the Platinum Chip Credit Card?
You can know the payment due date of your Platinum Chip Credit Card through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.
Which Bank issues a Credit Card at no cost?
ICICI Bank issues the Platinum Chip Credit Card without any joining fee and annual fee. For more information, call on 1800 1080.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please  click here .
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000 at HPCL fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
How do the chip and PIN improve security?
The chip and PIN provide robust protection against Card misuse by requiring a PIN for in-person transactions. This prevents unauthorized access even if the card is lost or stolen, significantly reducing the risk of fraudulent use.
When is the PIN required for transactions?
The PIN is required for transactions made on POS terminals (swipe machines) at merchant outlets in physical locations. Customers must enter their PIN on the terminal to complete the transaction securely.
Is PIN required for online transactions?
No, the PIN is not required for online transactions. Online payments can be completed without entering the PIN, but other security measures may still apply, such as OTP verification.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.
