FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transaction from ₹400 - ₹4000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?
The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹1 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. Flip your Rubyx Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Interest Charge

Late Payment Fee

Over-the-Limit Fee

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. What is a Credit Card?

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

What is Credit Card balance?

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

What are the criteria for availing domestic airport lounge access?
To enjoy domestic airport lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Sapphiro Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.
For customers with dual Credit Card variants (MasterCard and Amex), the entitlement includes 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter for each variant.
Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria,  click here . To view the complete list of lounges,  click here .
What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?
As a Sapphiro Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail of a maximum of 4 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit https://teetimes.truztee.com/ and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.
To view the updated list of golf courses, please  click here . For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please  click here . You may also call iAssist, the 24/7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform https://teetimes.truztee.com/ with your registered mobile number.
Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.
Submit your booking request and await confirmation.
Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

What are the key features of the concierge services offered?
The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).
What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?
The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards, please  click here .
What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?
Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (Add-On) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
How can I avoid the annual fee of the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card?
If you spend over ₹6 lakh, you can get your annual fee waived off for the next year.
What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find the CVV in my Sapphiro Credit Card?
Flip your Sapphiro Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
Which bank’s Credit Card should I opt for?
The ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card is an excellent choice. It offers premium perks like Reward Points, complimentary airport lounge access, buy one get one offer on BookMyShow and welcome offers from Uber, EaseMyTrip, Croma, Tata CLiQ and more.
What is the age limit to apply for Sapphiro Credit Card?
You must be between the ages of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card.
How do I know the Due Date of an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can find your ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card’s Due Date on your monthly statement, on the ICICI Bank's iMobile app, through Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please  click here .
What are the differences between the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card’s Amex and Mastercard variants?
The core benefits remain the same. Differences are mainly in card network acceptance, lounge access allocation per variant, and select merchant offers based on Amex or Mastercard.
Is the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card suitable for frequent travellers in 2026?
Yes, the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card offers travel-related features such as lounge access and reward points , subject to eligibility and applicable terms.
What is the minimum credit limit for the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card?
The credit limit is assigned based on income, credit profile, and internal assessment criteria defined by ICICI Bank.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Fuel Credit Card FAQs
What are Fuel Credit Cards?
Fuel Credit Cards are specially designed Credit Cards that help customers save on everyday fuel expenses while enjoying the convenience of cashless payments. ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Cards offer benefits such as fuel surcharge waivers, cashback on fuel spends, ​​​​points and savings at partner fuel stations. Depending on the card variant, customers may also enjoy accelerated ​​​​rewards on everyday spending categories such as groceries and departmental stores along with ​​​​additional features such as roadside assistance, airport or railway lounge access and dining or entertainment benefit
What is a fuel surcharge waiver on a Credit Card? What are the other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card?
A fuel surcharge waiver is a Fuel Credit Card benefit from ICICI Bank, waiving off the additional fee or surcharge that is typically added to fuel purchases. You can avail this benefit if you have a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank. Other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card include cashback, reward points on fuel purchases and exclusive discounts on other utilities, making this fuel Credit Card an excellent choice for savings on fuel expenses.
Can I use a Fuel Credit Card at any fuel station?
You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank and use it at most fuel stations, but the best benefits are usually applicable only at specific partner outlets. Using the Card at pumps other than the partner pumps might not offer rewards or surcharge waivers, so read the terms and conditions carefully before applying for a Card or using it.
Are there Credit Cards specifically for diesel as fuel?
Cashback and Reward points on most Fuel Credit Cards apply to diesel purchases also. They also offer surcharge waivers on fuel spends, regardless of fuel type. However, always check the Card’s terms and partner fuel stations to reconfirm whether diesel purchases are eligible for benefits and rewards.
Is there an option to apply for an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card online?
You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch and a Bank representative will help you apply for a Credit Card. Keep your documents like proof of identity, proof of address and Income statements handy.
How can I use an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card for an in-store purchase?
To use your ICICI Bank Credit Card for an in-store purchase, just swipe or tap your card on the card machine and enter your Personal Identification Number (PIN).
How can I pay the bill for my ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card?
You can pay your ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card bill through Net Banking, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), by setting up the Auto Debit facility for your account or by visiting an ICICI Bank branch or an Automated Teller Machine (ATM).
How can I check my Credit Card details online?
To check your ICICI Bank Credit Card details, log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app. Here, you can view all the details related to your Credit Card.
What is a petroleum Credit Card?
A petroleum Credit Card is the same as a Fuel Credit Card. This Credit Card is designed to offer savings on fuel purchases. ICICI Bank’s Fuel Credit Cards provide cashback, reward points and fuel surcharge waivers when used at petrol pumps. These Cards partner with fuel companies and are perfect for daily commuters looking to reduce monthly fuel costs while earning rewards.
What are the key features of a fuel Credit Card?
Fuel Credit Cards offer fuel-related savings and convenient payment features designed around everyday fuel purchases. Depending on the card variant, cardholders can enjoy cashback on fuel spends at HPCL fuel stations, fuel surcharge waivers and additional savings through partner payment platforms.
ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card
Save up to 5% on fuel purchases at any HPCL fuel pump when the Card is swiped on any bank’s POS machine or used via the HP Pay app.
The savings include 4% cashback (capped at ₹200 per month) and a 1% fuel surcharge waiver.
Get an additional 1.5% cashback as Happy Coins on fuel purchases made through the HP Pay app at HPCL outlets.
ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card
Save up to 3.5% on fuel purchases at any HPCL fuel pump.
Enjoy 2.5% cashback on fuel transactions (capped at ₹100 per month) when the Card is swiped at HPCL fuel pumps.
Receive a 1% fuel surcharge waiver when payments are made at HPCL fuel pumps using an ICICI Bank POS machine.
Both variants also support secure and contactless payments, making fuel transactions quick and convenient.
What are the eligibility criteria for a fuel credit card?
For both the ​​​​ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card and ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card, applicants must be Indian residents aged above 21 years. Salaried individuals should have a minimum monthly income of ₹20,000, while self-employed individuals should have a minimum annual income of ₹2.4 lakh. Applicants may also be required to submit documents such as identity proof, address proof and income proof during the application process. Card approval and issuance are subject to ICICI Bank’s internal policies and verification.
How long does it take to get approval for a Fuel Credit Card?
The approval timeline for an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card may vary depending on factors such as eligibility verification, completeness of the application, accuracy of information submitted and internal processing. In some cases, approval may be instant, while in others, it may take additional time based on verification requirements. Applicants can also track their Credit Card application status online after applying.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?
The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.
Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card?
To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.
How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?
You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.
How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?
To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:
1. Select the movie you want to watch
2. Click on ‘Book tickets’
3. Select the location and venue
4. Select the number of seats and proceed
5. Click on ‘Pay’
6. Accept the T&Cs

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?
You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.
What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.
Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?
You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.
Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?
The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.
How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?
ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver.
Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?
Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.
Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?
Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.
Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?
Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icici.bank.in
How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?
Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.
What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Chip Credit Cards come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.
How to generate my Plus (Add-On) Card PIN?
Pin can be generated through iMobile (Only by Primary Cardholder):
Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.
Customer Care:
(To be done by Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder, if Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder phone number is updated):
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.
How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:
Visit the BookMyShow website
Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets
Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”
Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”
Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction
How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.
Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver.
Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?
Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.
Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?
Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.
Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?
Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icici.bank.in
How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?
Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.
What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Chip Credit Cards come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.
How to generate my Plus (Add-On) Card PIN?
Pin can be generated through iMobile (Only by Primary Cardholder):
Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.
Customer Care:
(To be done by Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder, if Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder phone number is updated):
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.
How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:
Visit the BookMyShow website
Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets
Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”
Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”
Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction
How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.
Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Domestic Lounge Programme
Every journey now feels exceptional with a premium Domestic Airport Lounge Programme that provides access to an exclusive network of 80+ exquisite domestic airport lounges across India. Step into an environment designed for comfort, where you can relax, rejuvenate and enhance your travel experience.
Enjoy curated amenities including refined ambience, gourmet refreshments, comfortable seating and a perfect escape from the airport crowd. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.
Access to domestic lounges is available through your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card, ensuring a seamless and elevated travel experience.
Note: We have updated the eligibility criteria for our domestic lounge access to enhance your travel experience. To avail this benefit, you must spend a minimum of ₹75,000 or more on your eligible Credit Card within a calendar quarter. The eligible spend entitles you to access lounge benefits in the subsequent calendar quarter.
Domestic airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders.
Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cards, Diamant Credit Cards and Times Black Credit Cards provide complimentary unlimited domestic lounge access.
For the customers with dual Credit Card variants of Rubyx and Sapphiro (Mastercard & Amex / Visa & RuPay), the benefit will be equally distributed amongst both the variants.

International Lounge Programme
Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.
With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.
Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.
The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.
The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?
The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.
Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card?
To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.
How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?
You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.
How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?
To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:
1. Select the movie you want to watch
2. Click on ‘Book tickets’
3. Select the location and venue
4. Select the number of seats and proceed
5. Click on ‘Pay’
6. Accept the T&Cs
7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button
8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option
9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)
10. Enter the entire Credit Card number
11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message.
What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?
You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.
What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.
Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?
You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.
Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?
The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.
How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?
ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver.
Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?
Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.
Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?
Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.
Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?
Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icici.bank.in
How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?
Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.
What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Chip Credit Cards come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.
How to generate my Plus (Add-On) Card PIN?
Pin can be generated through iMobile (Only by Primary Cardholder):
Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.
Customer Care:
(To be done by Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder, if Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder phone number is updated):
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.
How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:
Visit the BookMyShow website
Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets
Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”
Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”
Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction
How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.
Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.
