Credit
When you buy something today and pay for it later, you have just taken Credit.
Simply put, credit can help you get the things you want when you don't have enough cash.
Your credit card is a form of credit - a substitute for money in the form of a plastic card enabling you to buy now but pay later.
You can use them to make purchases in millions of places, both in store or online.
You can also use Credit Cards for Balance Transfers and taking out cash from an ATM.
And if you need money for an emergency or unforeseen expenditure, you don't have to apply for loans at the eleventh hour – you already carry one in the form of a credit card.
Secured Credit Card
The ICICI Bank Instant Credit Card is a secured credit card, i.e., it is issued against the security of a Fixed Deposit. It is an excellent choice to help you begin building a good credit score.
Credit Score
Your credit score is a number that indicates to lenders how "credit worthy" you are.
It is calculated using records of how well you are repaying or have repaid any credit.
Most lenders provide repayment information to credit reference agencies or credit bureaus (CIBIL in India) which calculate and maintain your credit score.
This score is used for decisions on whether to lend further to you, without which, it is difficult for lenders to know whether you will repay your borrowing on time.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Auto Debit FAQs
What is the Auto Debit facility?
It is a facility offered by ICICI Bank which allows your payment to be made automatically on the scheduled date.
What is Auto Debit facility for a Credit Card?
As an ICICI Bank Credit Cardholder, you can automate your Credit Card bill payments with this facility.
How does the Auto Debit facility work?
You need to register for Auto Debit and choose the account from which the payment will be made. Ensure that you maintain sufficient funds in the selected account. The amount will be deducted on the scheduled date automatically.
What are the benefits of Auto Debit?
Setting up the Auto Debit facility for an ICICI Bank Credit Card will provide convenience by automating your regular payments. There are zero charges for setting up Auto Debit.
How can I register for the Auto Debit Facility?
You can call on 1800 1080 and ask the executive to sign you up for the facility or if you already have an Internet Banking User ID, click here . If you don't have an Internet Banking User ID, click here. You can also log in to the iMobile app and register for Auto Debit.
What if the payment is scheduled on a holiday?
If the scheduled date happens to be a holiday or on a weekend, the payment will be made a day prior.
Is there a Processing Fee for the Auto Debit facility?
There is no Processing Fee for this facility.
How can I remove auto debit from my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can disable auto debit using ICICI Bank’s iMobile app or Net Banking under card services.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?
The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.
Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card?
To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.
How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?
You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.
How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?
To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:
1. Select the movie you want to watch
2. Click on ‘Book tickets’
3. Select the location and venue
4. Select the number of seats and proceed
5. Click on ‘Pay’
6. Accept the T&Cs
7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button
8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option
9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)
10. Enter the entire Credit Card number
11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message.
What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?
You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.
What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.
Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?
You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.
Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?
The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.
How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?
ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver.
Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?
Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.
Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?
Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.
Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?
Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icici.bank.in
How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?
Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.
What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Chip Credit Cards come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.
How to generate my Plus (Add-On) Card PIN?
Pin can be generated through iMobile (Only by Primary Cardholder):
Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.
Customer Care:
(To be done by Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder, if Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder phone number is updated):
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.
How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:
Visit the BookMyShow website
Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets
Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”
Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”
Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction
How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.
Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

International Lounge Programme
Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.
With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.
Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.
The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.
The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?
The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.
Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card?
To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.
How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?
You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.
How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?
To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:
1. Select the movie you want to watch
2. Click on ‘Book tickets’
3. Select the location and venue
4. Select the number of seats and proceed
5. Click on ‘Pay’
6. Accept the T&Cs
7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button
8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option
9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)
10. Enter the entire Credit Card number
11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message.
What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?
You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.
What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.
Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?
You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.
Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?
The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.
How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?
ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver.
Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?
Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.
Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?
Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.
Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?
Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icici.bank.in
How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?
Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.
What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Chip Credit Cards come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.
How to generate my Plus (Add-On) Card PIN?
Pin can be generated through iMobile (Only by Primary Cardholder):
Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.
Customer Care:
(To be done by Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder, if Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder phone number is updated):
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.
How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:
Visit the BookMyShow website
Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets
Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”
Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”
Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction
How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.
Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Auto Debit Facility
Auto Debit Facility on Credit Card
The Auto Debit facility on Credit Card allows you to conveniently manage your finances by making secure automated payments on scheduled dates.
What are the benefits of the Auto Debit facility?
Flexible Payments
Hassle free Credit Card bill payment without any intervention.
Multiple Autodebit Modes
You can now choose *Minimum Amount Due or Total Amount Due payment as per your convenience.
Advanced Scheduling
Schedule your payment in advance and it will be made accordingly.
Zero Charges
The Auto Debit facility is free of cost.
How to set up the Auto Debit facility?
Internet Banking
iMobile App
Log into your Internet Banking account
Go to Credit Cards in Cards & Loans section
Go to Auto Debit Setup
Select Card, Savings account number, Mode of Auto Debit setup
Login to iMobile App
Go to Manage Card in Card section
Register for Auto Debit
Select Savings account number for Auto Debit
Select mode: Total Amount Due or Min Amount Due
You can call on 1800 1080 for the same
Click here  to download the form to register for the Auto Debit facility.
Things you should know
There is no Processing Fee for this facility
Click here  to download the form for autodebit facility
Please read the Terms and Conditions  for Credit cards
Please refer to the  Most Important Terms & Conditions (MITC)  for other charges
Auto Debit FAQs
What is the Auto Debit facility?
It is a facility offered by ICICI Bank which allows your payment to be made automatically on the scheduled date.
What is Auto Debit facility for a Credit Card?
As an ICICI Bank Credit Cardholder, you can automate your Credit Card bill payments with this facility.
How does the Auto Debit facility work?
You need to register for Auto Debit and choose the account from which the payment will be made. Ensure that you maintain sufficient funds in the selected account. The amount will be deducted on the scheduled date automatically.
What are the benefits of Auto Debit?
Setting up the Auto Debit facility for an ICICI Bank Credit Card will provide convenience by automating your regular payments. There are zero charges for setting up Auto Debit.
How can I register for the Auto Debit Facility?
You can call on 1800 1080 and ask the executive to sign you up for the facility or if you already have an Internet Banking User ID, click here . If you don't have an Internet Banking User ID, click here. You can also log in to the iMobile app and register for Auto Debit.
What if the payment is scheduled on a holiday?
If the scheduled date happens to be a holiday or on a weekend, the payment will be made a day prior.
Is there a Processing Fee for the Auto Debit facility?
There is no Processing Fee for this facility.
How can I remove auto debit from my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can disable auto debit using ICICI Bank’s iMobile app or Net Banking under card services.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

How to apply for a Credit Card with ICICI Bank
Here are the steps to apply online for an ICICI Bank Credit Card:

After submitting your details, your new Credit Card will be issued post approval via an internal review process.
Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

Credit Terms – A To Z Of Credit

Credit Dictionary - A to Z of Credit
Credit Terms – A To Z Of Credit
Empower yourself with this easy to follow dictionary – a compilation of terms to help you understand credit cards better.

Account or Card Number
This number (on the front of your credit card) represents your Credit card account.
Annual Fee
A fee you pay once a year for the use of a credit card . This fee is not based on your balance and has no impact on your interest or credit limit. It's usually a single, flat fee charged once a year.
Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
The yearly percentage rate of interest charged when a balance outstanding is held (i.e not re-paid) on a credit card.
Auto Debit
An instruction given by you for automatically transferring payments from your savings account to your Credit Card account.
Bad Credit
This usually means a poor credit score or credit rating. Many things can damage your credit score, like missed payments, late payments or default on payments.
Cash Advance
The amount of cash your withdraw using your credit card at a bank or ATM. This cash is withdrawn from your Card account and draws interest from the day of withdrawal itself – there is no grace period or interest holiday on this amount.
Cash Limit
The maximum amount of cash that you can withdraw on your credit card account. Cash-Limit forms a subset of your overall Credit Limit.
Card member
The person that the credit card was issued to, or another person who is authorized to use the card.
Card Verification Value or CVV
A three digit security code, usually found on the back of your credit card, above the signature. This code is unique to each card and is sometimes used to identify you for secure Internet, mail or phone purchases.
Card Verification Value or CVV
A three digit security code, usually found on the back of your credit card, above the signature. This code is unique to each card and is sometimes used to identify you for secure Internet, mail or phone purchases.
Chargeback
If you find a fraudulent or unauthorized transaction on your card account, you need to report the same to the card issuing company. They may temporarily reverse the transaction in your account till the investigation into fraud charges are completed. This reversal is often referred to as a "chargeback".
Chargeslip
A paper slip generated when your transaction is authorized using a swipe machine at a shop or store. You will be asked to sign the chargeslip as proof of your acceptance and authorization of such transaction on your card account. Also see swipe machines.
Collateral
Money or assets (such as property) that you put down as security to prove to a lender that you're able to pay back what you owe. In case of default on payments, lenders are likely to take possession of the collateral to make good their dues.
Credit
Credit means buying something now and paying for it at a later date with or without interest.
Credit Bureau
An organization that collects details of credit behaviour from various sources to create your credit score or credit rating. These credit scores and ratings create your credit history overtime.
Credit Card Number
The number stamped or embossed on your credit card. Also see Account number.
Credit History
The history of your credit use. It lists whether or not you've made your payments on time, stayed within your limit and practiced good credit habits.
Credit Limit
The highest amount of money you are authorized to spend on your credit card account. Going over your credit limit often can affect your credit score and you may be charged a fee.
Credit Report
A report showing a "snapshot" of your credit history in Canada that you can request from the credit bureaus. Detailed reports can be purchased for a reasonable fee, but simpler versions can often be ordered by mail for free.
Credit Score
This is a number that reflects your general "credit worthiness". Created by credit bureaus, it's one of the factors lenders use when deciding to give you credit. Also see Credit Bureau.
Default
Generally, the failure to make your payments. When you don't make your payments on time, you're said to have "defaulted".
Delinquent account
When you don't make your payments against loans or credit cards on time, your loan or card account is termed as "Delinquent account"
EMI
EMI refers to Equated Monthly Installments. When you make a large purchase or take a large loan, you can choose to pay back over a fixed period of time. The amount to be paid back (principal + interest) is divided into equal parts that you need to pay every month. This is termed as an "Equated Monthly Installment".
Fraudulent Transaction
An unauthorized use of your account or credit card without your knowledge or consent.
Fraudulent User
Someone other than you who uses your card or account without your consent.
Grace Period
A length of time in which a lender will allow you to pay your credit balance without paying interest and/or late fees. This is a feature of most credit cards except in case of Cash advances.
Interest Rate
The percentage rate of interest charged when a balance outstanding is held (i.e not re-paid) on a credit card. This is usually stated as a monthly or yearly rate.
Lender
In reference to the world of credit, "Lender" usually means any financial institution or company that gives you access to credit, such as credit cards, lines of credit, or mortgages.
Late Payment Charges or LPC
Most Credit cards allow a fixed time or grace period towards credit card outstanding. A failure to make the payment on time often attracts a penalty in the form of Late Payment Charges. This is usually a fixed amount and not related to the amount of outstanding payment due. Also see Grace period.
Merchant Establishment
The shop or company or establishment where you use your credit card, including for online purchases. Merchant establishments may ask you to authenticate your card transactions and are custodians of the card swiping machines
Minimum Amount Due or MAD
The absolute minimum amount you need to pay on your credit card balance every month to keep your account in good standing and to avoid LPC. This is usually a percentage of the total amount outstanding on your card account.
Network
VISA, MasterCard and American Express are key "network" companies that allow information exchange between merchant establishments and credit card issuing companies to authorize and track transactions all over the world.
Overlimit
Any credit used on a credit account that has gone over the credit limit. Most credit card companies will allow, rather than decline such transactions to avoid inconvenience of a declined transaction. You may be charged extra fees for this.
Overlimit Charges / Fee
A fee you may be charged for allowing your balance to go above your credit limit.
Payment Due Date
This refers to the date every month, on which the payment towards your card or loan account is due. If payments are missed on this date, your account will attract penalty or interest charges or both.
Phishing
E-mail fraud, or "phishing", is an Internet scam in the form of an e-mail. The e-mails link to sites that look like well-known legitimate businesses and ask you to provide or confirm personal, financial, or password information. Always check the url displayed before filling up information online – the urls will not be those of your financial institution in case of a phishing scam.
Principal
Principal or principal amount refers to the base amount of money that has been lent to you. Any charges or interest are calculated on this base amount and together principal, interest and charges form the total amount you may need to pay back to the lenders.
PIN
The Personal Identification Number allocated to you by the Bank or chosen by you which is used for authenticating the Card member.
Revolving Credit
Payment towards your credit card account is normally due on a set date or payment due date. If you make partial or no payments on this date, you access "revolving credit" as the outstanding on your card account has now exceeded the grace period and has "revolved" into a new payment cycle. Revolving credit will attract interest charges.
Secured Credit Cards
Unlike unsecured credit cards, these are cards that require you to offer collateral or security. At ICICI Bank, such security is required in the form of a Fixed Deposit. Secured credit cards are recommended for newcomers with no credit history or those who are trying to improve their credit rating.
Supplementary Card member
Another person who shares your credit account – usually a family member. As the main card member, you will still be responsible for all transactions, usage and payments.
Security Deposit
A sum of money, paid up front, as security in case a borrower defaults on their credit. In case of Secured Credit Cards, this is usually in the form of a Fixed Deposit with the issuing Bank.
Statement
A document from your lender that lists all the transactions you have made on your account or your payment schedules. This is usually sent once a month.
Swiping machine
Electronic data capturing machines that you see at stores and shops which are used to swipe your card in order to access information to authorize your transaction
Terms & Conditions
The terms and conditions applicable to the product or service or line of credit that you have taken from a bank or lender. The most updated Terms & Conditions are mostly available on the lender's website.
Total Amount Due or TAD
The total amount you need to pay on your credit card. This amount should match all the transactions or purchases that you have made on your card account.

Platinum Chip Credit Card FAQs
Is there a joining fee or annual fee for Platinum Chip Credit Card?
The Platinum Chip Credit Card has no joining fee or annual fee.
What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it on my ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card?
Flip your Platinum Chip Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.
Which bank’s Credit Card should I opt for?
The ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card is an excellent choice. It has no joining fee or annual fee.
What is the age limit to apply for a Platinum Chip Credit Card?
You must be between the ages of 21-65 years to be eligible to apply for an ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card.
How to know the payment due date of the Platinum Chip Credit Card?
You can know the payment due date of your Platinum Chip Credit Card through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.
Which Bank issues a Credit Card at no cost?
ICICI Bank issues the Platinum Chip Credit Card without any joining fee and annual fee. For more information, call on 1800 1080.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please  click here .
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000 at HPCL fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
How do the chip and PIN improve security?
The chip and PIN provide robust protection against Card misuse by requiring a PIN for in-person transactions. This prevents unauthorized access even if the card is lost or stolen, significantly reducing the risk of fraudulent use.
When is the PIN required for transactions?
The PIN is required for transactions made on POS terminals (swipe machines) at merchant outlets in physical locations. Customers must enter their PIN on the terminal to complete the transaction securely.
Is PIN required for online transactions?
No, the PIN is not required for online transactions. Online payments can be completed without entering the PIN, but other security measures may still apply, such as OTP verification.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card FAQs
What are the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card benefits for new and renewal cardholders?
When you pay the joining fee of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card, you receive a MakeMyTrip voucher worth ₹1,000 that is valid for one year. Upon renewal, you get a ₹1,000 MakeMyTrip hotel voucher that is valid for three months. Finally, you also receive a complimentary one-year MMTBLACK Gold membership with added benefits and discounts. These benefits make your travel bookings even more rewarding.
Why have I received two MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card is offered as a dual proposition with both Mastercard and RuPay variants. You receive both Cards to provide enhanced network flexibility, ensuring seamless usage across a wider range of merchants and platforms.
How do I complete the KYC verification for my MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Provide your PAN and Aadhaar details and then complete video KYC with an ICICI Bank employee by answering a few questions and showing your original PAN card. The Video KYC process is available 24/7 for your convenience.
Does the myCash earned through MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Cards expire?
The myCash earned through the new MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Cards does not expire once credited to the primary Cardholder's MakeMyTrip wallet. However, myCash earned through the older MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature and Platinum Credit Cards expires within 12 months of the credit date
Can I apply for a MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card if I already have an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can apply for a MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card even if you already hold another ICICI Bank Credit Card. Your application will be processed based on the bank's internal policies. If approved, you will retain ownership of your existing ICICI Bank Credit Card and also get the new Credit Card.
What benefits does the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card offer?
The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card offers several exclusive benefits including the MMTBLACK Platinum membership, savings of up to ₹3,600 annually on movie tickets booked on BookMyShow and the opportunity to earn 40,000 myCash points during travel. You will also receive MakeMyTrip holiday vouchers worth ₹2,500 and 1,500 myCash points on paying the joining fee. The joining fee for this Card is ₹2,500.
What are the features of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?
The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card offers a range of travel benefits, including a myCash benefit worth ₹500. Cardholders receive a holiday voucher worth ₹3,000 and complimentary domestic airport and railway lounge access. The nominal joining fee for this Card is ₹500 and you can avail benefits worth up to ₹20,000 (T&Cs apply).
What makes the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card unique?
The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card stands out with its unlimited myCash rewards that never expire and the ability to earn up to 6% myCash on MakeMyTrip bookings and 1% myCash on other retail purchases. It also provides complimentary lounge access at both domestic and international airports. The Card includes benefits like discounted movie tickets, a minimal joining fee of ₹999, and a one-year MMTBLACK Gold Membership, among other perks.

Fuel Credit Card FAQs
What are Fuel Credit Cards?
Fuel Credit Cards are specially designed Credit Cards that help customers save on everyday fuel expenses while enjoying the convenience of cashless payments. ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Cards offer benefits such as fuel surcharge waivers, cashback on fuel spends, ​​​​points and savings at partner fuel stations. Depending on the card variant, customers may also enjoy accelerated ​​​​rewards on everyday spending categories such as groceries and departmental stores along with ​​​​additional features such as roadside assistance, airport or railway lounge access and dining or entertainment benefit
What is a fuel surcharge waiver on a Credit Card? What are the other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card?
A fuel surcharge waiver is a Fuel Credit Card benefit from ICICI Bank, waiving off the additional fee or surcharge that is typically added to fuel purchases. You can avail this benefit if you have a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank. Other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card include cashback, reward points on fuel purchases and exclusive discounts on other utilities, making this fuel Credit Card an excellent choice for savings on fuel expenses.
Can I use a Fuel Credit Card at any fuel station?
You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank and use it at most fuel stations, but the best benefits are usually applicable only at specific partner outlets. Using the Card at pumps other than the partner pumps might not offer rewards or surcharge waivers, so read the terms and conditions carefully before applying for a Card or using it.
Are there Credit Cards specifically for diesel as fuel?
Cashback and Reward points on most Fuel Credit Cards apply to diesel purchases also. They also offer surcharge waivers on fuel spends, regardless of fuel type. However, always check the Card’s terms and partner fuel stations to reconfirm whether diesel purchases are eligible for benefits and rewards.
Is there an option to apply for an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card online?
You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch and a Bank representative will help you apply for a Credit Card. Keep your documents like proof of identity, proof of address and Income statements handy.
How can I use an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card for an in-store purchase?
To use your ICICI Bank Credit Card for an in-store purchase, just swipe or tap your card on the card machine and enter your Personal Identification Number (PIN).
How can I pay the bill for my ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card?
You can pay your ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card bill through Net Banking, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), by setting up the Auto Debit facility for your account or by visiting an ICICI Bank branch or an Automated Teller Machine (ATM).
How can I check my Credit Card details online?
To check your ICICI Bank Credit Card details, log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app. Here, you can view all the details related to your Credit Card.
What is a petroleum Credit Card?
A petroleum Credit Card is the same as a Fuel Credit Card. This Credit Card is designed to offer savings on fuel purchases. ICICI Bank’s Fuel Credit Cards provide cashback, reward points and fuel surcharge waivers when used at petrol pumps. These Cards partner with fuel companies and are perfect for daily commuters looking to reduce monthly fuel costs while earning rewards.

Fuel Credit Cards offer fuel-related savings and convenient payment features designed around everyday fuel purchases. Depending on the card variant, cardholders can enjoy cashback on fuel spends at HPCL fuel stations, fuel surcharge waivers and additional savings through partner payment platforms.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.
