Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage
Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants
Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity
Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies
Never save your Card information on any websites
Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone
Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions
In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

What is a Credit Card?

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

What is Credit Card balance?

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee

GST

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

About Prepaid Cards
What is a Prepaid Card?
A Prepaid Card is a payment card that allows users to load funds in advance and use it for transactions until the balance is exhausted. Unlike credit or debit cards, Prepaid Cards are not linked to a bank account and do not require a credit check. They offer convenience and security for various financial needs, including travel, online shopping and corporate expenses.
How long is my ICICI Bank Prepaid Card valid for?
The validity of the card is 5 years from the date of issue i.e. "Valid From' as printed on the card.
Where can I check the balance on the card?
You can check the balance on the card with the help of the below options:
Calling our Customer Care
At any Visa enabled ATM, across India
Prepaid Card FAQs
What will happen if the card gets closed after 5 years?
Customer can request for replacement card by calling our ICICI Bank Customer care at 1800 1080
Do I need to keep a minimum balance on the Card?
There is no need to keep a minimum balance on the Card. However, keeping a healthy balance on your Card will help you utilise it, in the case of an emergency.
Can I get a refund for the unutilised amount instead of a replacement card?
Yes, you may request a refund, subject to the Bank's discretion based on the type of Prepaid Card and other factors.
What if I forget the ATM PIN of the Card?
If you forget your PIN, you can generate a new PIN with the help of the below options: - Call our Customer Care at 1800 1080

Surat Money Card
EXPAND ALL
What if my card is lost, stolen or damaged?
If your card is lost, stolen or damaged, you need to immediately block the card by calling our Customer Care on 1800-266-9849.
You can apply for a replacement card (after blocking of your previous card) at the card issuance counters mentioned above. Your last updated card balance will be transferred from your previous card to your new card. In case of pass, your previous pass will be provided on the new card as well.
Please note: Card replacement charges apply.
What is Surat Money Card? Why should I take this card?
Surat Money is a prepaid card presented to you by ICICI Bank and Surat Municipal Corporation. This card enables you to make cashless payments in the city of Surat. So, drive away the hassles of carrying change, make payments with ease and track your expenses as well with this card.
Where can I use my Surat Money Card?
The card can be used for making payments at:
Bus Rapid Transit System (BRTS) and City Bus travel tickets and passes
Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Civic Centres for tax and bill payments
Service delivery outlets for reloading your card and bill payment
Shopping and restaurants
E-commerce transactions
Where can I get my Surat Money Card? What are the issuance charges?
Please refer to ‘Issuance Locations’ section for finding out your nearest Surat Money issuance counter. The card is free of cost.
How can I recharge my card? Is there a minimum or maximum limit for recharge?
You can recharge your card by paying cash at BRTS station counters, designated civic centres of Surat Municipal Corporation and Service Delivery Points spread across Surat. Please refer to the section Issuance Locations for details. First time recharge is a minimum of Rs 100. Subsequently the recharges can be in multiples of Rs 50. The maximum balance that your card can have is Rs 10,000.
How can I utilise the balance on my card?
There are 2 types of balances on your card:
The total balance of your card which is exactly equal to the recharge amount is called the total account balance.
The balance on your card which is available for purpose of travel on BRTS and city buses is called the CARD BALANCE.
What is the validity of this card? What happens to my balance after the card expires?
This card has a validity of 5 years. Post card expiry, you can apply for a new card and your last updated balance will be transferred from your old card to your new card. In case of pass, your previous pass will be provided on the new card as well.
Is my card safe to use?
Yes, your Surat Money Card is safe to use as your non-travel transactions are authenticated by using a PIN.
How can I activate my card?
You can activate your card by doing a simple PIN SET and a top-up of Rs 100.
Where do I contact for any grievances?
You may call our 24-hour Customer Care on 1800-266-9849 in case of any grievance.

About Multi Wallet Prepaid Card
Multi Wallet Prepaid Card
ICICI Bank’s Multi Wallet Prepaid Card offers an efficient way to manage employee benefits, with customisable wallet options that allow you to set spending restrictions based on Merchant Category Codes (MCCs). Tailored to meet requirements of companies, this Card ensures seamless transactions and ease of use.
How to apply for the Multi Wallet Prepaid Card
For ICICI Bank Account Holders
1. Log In
Begin by logging into your ICICI Bank Net Banking account.
2. Navigate to ‘Cards and Loans’
Click on the ‘Cards and Loans’ tab located on the homepage.
3. Select ‘Prepaid Cards’
From the list, select ‘Prepaid Cards’ to begin your application.
4. Enter Corporate Details
Enter your Corporate ID (8-digit alphanumeric ID or 17-digit numeric ID) and Corporate Name.
5. Choose Card Type
Select ‘Multi Wallet Card’ from the dropdown menu.
6. Select Application Type
From the dropdown menu, choose ‘New Card Application’.
7. Verify Employee ID
Enter your Employee ID for identification.
8. Review Personal Details
Check the personal details that get auto-populated, to ensure correctness.
9. Submit Application
Click in the checkbox to accept the T&Cs and submit your application.
For Non-ICICI Bank Account Holders
Non-ICICI Bank Account Holders can apply for the Multi Wallet Prepaid Card at the specially-created portal here that makes the application process simple and convenient.
Support and Contact Information

Contact your ICICI Bank Relationship Manager
Send an e-mail to mwcenquiry@icicibank.com
Multi Wallet Prepaid Card FAQs
What is the ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
The ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card is a magnetic strip-based reloadable Prepaid Card, which is loaded in Indian Rupees. You can use this card to shop at merchant establishments that accept Credit and Debit Cards.
Where can I use my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
The ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card can be used at any merchant establishment (shop, department store, movie theatre, restaurant etc.) that accepts VISA Credit or Debit Cards. However, the usage of the Card depends upon the wallet configuration as directed by your company.
How soon after getting my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card can I start using it?
Your Card is activated once KYC is completed. It is loaded with funds for use once ICICI Bank receives the funds for the Card from your company.
How long is my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card valid for?
The validity of the Card is 5 years from the date of issue on the Card.
What about the available balance on the Card after the Card has expired?
You can place a request at our Customer Care for a replacement Card. The available balance will be transferred to the new Card when it is issued. Replacement charges of ₹200 + GST will be levied for the new Card.
Are there any charges for the usage of my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
There is no charge levied on the Card for spends at any merchant establishment or for checking the Card balance at any ICICI Bank ATM. However, balance enquiry done at any other bank’s ATM shall attract charges. For detailed charges, please visit the ‘Fees and Charges’ tab under the ‘Prepaid Card’ section on our website www.icicibank.com .
Can I add funds to my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
No. Funds can be added to your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card only by your company by way of your salary and reimbursements. There is no restriction on the number of times a Card can be reloaded.
Where can I check the balance on my Card?
You can check the balance on your Card using any of the below methods:
Send the following SMS to 5676766 / 9215676766:  PCBAL<Space>Last 4 digits of the Card
Call our Customer Care on 1800 1080
Check at any VISA-enabled ATM in India
Check using the ICICI Bank InstaBIZ app.
Where can I get details of the last transaction that I have made using my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
You can get the last 10 transactions made on your Card by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080. Alternatively, you can also log into the Self Care Portal with your User ID and Password for getting the details.
Do I need to maintain a minimum balance on my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
There is no need to maintain a minimum balance on your Card. However, keeping a healthy balance on your Card will help you in times of emergency.
Can I use an ATM to check the amount remaining on my Card?
Most ATMs have the facility to check the balance on your Card. However, cash withdrawal is not permitted.
What if I forget the ATM PIN of my Card?
If you forget your PIN, you can generate a new PIN using any of the below methods:
Call our Customer Care on 1800 1080
Log into the Prepaid Card Self Care Portal at this link: https://inrprepaid.icicibank.com/customer/login.jsp
Send the following SMS to 5676766: PCPIN<Space>Last 4 digits of Card
Is the ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card a secured Card?
Absolutely. To ensure maximum security, sign inside the signature panel present on the reverse of your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card as soon as you get it. Every time you use your Card, you need to sign on the charge slip (produced by the Electronic Data Capture machine at the time of purchase) to complete the transaction at the merchant establishment. The merchant shall match this signature with the signature present on the back on your Card, thus ensuring protection against unauthorised usage of your Card.
What happens if my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card gets lost or stolen?
If your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card is lost or stolen, report it to our Customer Care on 1800 1080 immediately, so that your Card can be blocked to prevent any misuse. We will then provide you with a replacement Card through your company.

Multi Wallet Prepaid Card FAQs
What is the ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
The ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card is a magnetic strip-based reloadable Prepaid Card, which is loaded in Indian Rupees. You can use this card to shop at merchant establishments that accept Credit and Debit Cards.
Where can I use my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
The ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card can be used at any merchant establishment (shop, department store, movie theatre, restaurant etc.) that accepts VISA Credit or Debit Cards. However, the usage of the Card depends upon the wallet configuration as directed by your company.
How soon after getting my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card can I start using it?
Your Card is activated once KYC is completed. It is loaded with funds for use once ICICI Bank receives the funds for the Card from your company.
How long is my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card valid for?
The validity of the Card is 5 years from the date of issue on the Card.
What about the available balance on the Card after the Card has expired?
You can place a request at our Customer Care for a replacement Card. The available balance will be transferred to the new Card when it is issued. Replacement charges of ₹200 + GST will be levied for the new Card.
Are there any charges for the usage of my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
There is no charge levied on the Card for spends at any merchant establishment or for checking the Card balance at any ICICI Bank ATM. However, balance enquiry done at any other bank’s ATM shall attract charges. For detailed charges, please visit the ‘Fees and Charges’ tab under the ‘Prepaid Card’ section on our website www.icicibank.com .
Can I add funds to my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
No. Funds can be added to your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card only by your company by way of your salary and reimbursements. There is no restriction on the number of times a Card can be reloaded.
Where can I check the balance on my Card?
You can check the balance on your Card using any of the below methods:
Send the following SMS to 5676766 / 9215676766:  PCBAL<Space>Last 4 digits of the Card
Call our Customer Care on 1800 1080
Check at any VISA-enabled ATM in India
Check using the ICICI Bank InstaBIZ app.
Where can I get details of the last transaction that I have made using my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
You can get the last 10 transactions made on your Card by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080. Alternatively, you can also log into the Self Care Portal with your User ID and Password for getting the details.
Do I need to maintain a minimum balance on my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
There is no need to maintain a minimum balance on your Card. However, keeping a healthy balance on your Card will help you in times of emergency.
Can I use an ATM to check the amount remaining on my Card?
Most ATMs have the facility to check the balance on your Card. However, cash withdrawal is not permitted.
What if I forget the ATM PIN of my Card?
If you forget your PIN, you can generate a new PIN using any of the below methods:
Call our Customer Care on 1800 1080
Log into the Prepaid Card Self Care Portal at this link: https://inrprepaid.icicibank.com/customer/login.jsp
Send the following SMS to 5676766: PCPIN<Space>Last 4 digits of Card
Is the ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card a secured Card?
Absolutely. To ensure maximum security, sign inside the signature panel present on the reverse of your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card as soon as you get it. Every time you use your Card, you need to sign on the charge slip (produced by the Electronic Data Capture machine at the time of purchase) to complete the transaction at the merchant establishment. The merchant shall match this signature with the signature present on the back on your Card, thus ensuring protection against unauthorised usage of your Card.
What happens if my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card gets lost or stolen?
If your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card is lost or stolen, report it to our Customer Care on 1800 1080 immediately, so that your Card can be blocked to prevent any misuse. We will then provide you with a replacement Card through your company.

About FASTag
About FASTag
FASTag is an easy-to-use, reloadable tag that is affixed on your vehicle's windscreen. It enables automatic deduction of toll charges, so you can pass through toll plazas without stopping to pay the fees manually. FASTag is linked to a prepaid account from which the applicable toll amounts are deducted.
The tag makes use of Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) technology to ensure that the relevant charges are automatically deducted from your prepaid account. So, you see, FASTag is the perfect solution on India’s national highways.

NETC | FASTag
National Electronic Toll Collection (NETC) programme has been launched by NPCI, NHAI and IHMCL to automate electronic toll collection to ease traffic woes and create an efficient and interoperable system on a national scale covering all toll plazas.
The Government of India (GOI) has mandated all toll plazas on the national highways to make toll payments electronic. According to the GOI plans, FASTag will be made compulsory on other toll plazas subsequently. Following this mandate, all vehicles travelling through toll plazas will now have to mandatorily pay their toll charges using FASTag. Many parking places in the country are also implementing contactless parking payment through FASTag.
NETC programme uses FASTag device that employs RFID technology, for making electronic toll payment directly from the prepaid account linked to it. Currently the programme is live on 650+ toll plazas across the country. FASTag offers the convenience of cashless payments along with other benefits like savings on fuel and time as the customer does not have to stop at the toll plazas.
ICICI Bank FASTag programme is part of NETC initiative rolled out by NPCI under the guidelines of NHAI and IHMCL.

FASTag FAQs
What to do if I have raised request for closure of my FASTag, but my FASTag is still showing as active in NPCI and IHMCL records.
If your closure request is approved, your FASTag will be first put in 03 exception code (low balance status) in NPCI and IHMCL records. After 15 days of approval of request, you will receive refund of balance in your wallet and your FASTag will then be added to 06 exception code (closed status) in NPCI and IHMCL records.
I have raised request for closure for my FASTag, but it is not approved and my tag is still active. How can I get my tag closed.
Your closure request will be verified by the Bank basis the documents submitted. The TAT for verification is 3 business days. After the request is approved, your tag will be added to 03 exception code (low balance status) to block tag from doing transactions. After 15 days of approval of request, you will receive refund of balance in your wallet and your FASTag will then be added to 06 exception code (closed status) in NPCI and IHMCL records. If any transactions are sent by toll plaza on blocked tag, you can raise a dispute on the transactions for getting refund from the toll plaza. Once toll plaza accepts the dispute, you will receive the refund.
I have raised request for closure of my FASTag, but it is rejected. How can I check the reason for rejection.
You can login to FASTag web portal - https://fastaglogin.icicibank.com/CUSTLOGIN/Default.aspx and check the activity history of the vehicle for which closure request was raised. The activity history will display the reason for rejection. You can raise request for closure again with valid documents. In case of urgent permanent blocking of tag (if you have sold the vehicle), you can click on “View tag account summary” and then click on “Manage Tags” under “Vehicles” Tab, click on “Manage” and mark the tag as Lost/Stolen to add the tag to 06 exception code (closed/permanent block).
What to do if my FASTag sticker is disabled and I am not able to activate.
If your FASTag is hotlisted due to negative balance, you can recharge with sufficient balance and activate. If your FASTag sticker is hotlisted because of incorrect vehicle number or not updating registration certificate, or any other reason, please upload your registration certificate and reach out to customer care number - 1800 2100 104. If your FASTag is showing as “Closed” in NPCI and IHMCL records, it cannot be activated again. You can take a new FASTag under your existing FASTag wallet if the status of your FASTag in ICICI FASTag portal - https://fastaglogin.icicibank.com/CUSTLOGIN/Default.aspx is “Returndamage” or “LOST” or “STOLEN”. However, if your FASTag status is “HEXTAGCLOSED” or “CLOSED” or “PENDING CLOSED” or “REFUND REQUESTED” or “SUSPENDED” or “WRITE OFF”, you need to create new FASTag account for new FASTag. Existing account can be closed by following the process for FASTag wallet closure.
I have not used my FASTag for a period of 1 year and my FASTag is disabled. How can I activate my FASTag.
If your FASTag is showing as “Closed” in NPCI and IHMCl records, it cannot be activated again. You can check your FASTag wallet status in ICICI Bank FASTag web portal - https://fastaglogin.icicibank.com/CUSTLOGIN/Default.aspx If your FASTag status is “HEXTAGCLOSED” or “CLOSED” or “PENDING CLOSED” or “REFUND REQUESTED” or “SUSPENDED” or “WRITE OFF”, you need to create new FASTag account for new FASTag. Existing account can be closed by following the process for FASTag wallet closure.
How to Apply ICICI Bank FASTag?
You can apply through ICICI Bank’s website, FASTag Customer Portal or authorised channels by submitting vehicle and KYC details.
Do I have to use a specific lane at a toll plaza for FASTag?
Yes. Use the designated FASTag lane at toll plazas to enable automatic electronic toll deduction.
How can I block my FASTag account in case my vehicle is lost?
Immediately log in to the FASTag Customer Portal or contact the toll-free number to block the FASTag.
Is FASTag accepted at all toll plazas in India?
FASTag is accepted at NETC-enabled toll plazas across India as per national electronic toll collection guidelines.

How to Recharge FASTag?
Recharging your FASTag is an easy procedure that offers flexibility and convenience. There are several options for doing this. Let us discuss two well-known methods of FASTag recharging:

elect ICICI Bank FASTag: Go to the app dashboard; under ‘Travel & Shop’ find the ‘ICICI Bank FASTag’ icon. This icon directs you to the FASTag management section

FASTag FAQs
What is the minimum/maximum amount of FASTag recharge?
When recharging your FASTag, you can start with a minimum of ₹100 and go up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000. This flexibility allows you to select any amount within this range that suits your needs when recharging your FASTag wallet.
Are there any charges for recharging FASTag?
No, there are no charges for recharging your FASTag account. However, there are certain charges related to getting one. These are:
Joining Fee: A one-time fee of ₹100 (including taxes) for activating your FASTag
Security Deposit: A refundable deposit varying by vehicle class, used if toll charges exceed your balance
Threshold Amount: A minimum recharge is required during activation, ensuring sufficient funds for immediate toll payments based on vehicle class.
What should I do if my FASTag recharge is not credited?
If you have recharged your FASTag account through the ICICI Bank portal and the amount is debited from your bank account but not credited to your FASTag, contact ICICI Bank Customer Service Centre immediately. Place a request to initiate a reversal of the transaction to ensure the funds are correctly credited to your FASTag account without delay.
Is FASTag recharge mandatory for all vehicles?
FASTag is mandatory for vehicles using electronic toll collection lanes as per regulatory guidelines. Maintaining sufficient balance ensures uninterrupted toll payments.
How to recharge FASTag by Vehicle Number?
Log in to ICICI Bank FASTag portal or supported digital platform, enter registered vehicle number, select recharge amount and complete payment using available methods.
How long does it take for FASTag recharge to reflect?
Recharge is usually reflected shortly after a successful transaction, subject to system processing timelines.
Can I recharge FASTag at a toll plaza?
FASTag recharge may be available at authorised toll plaza counters or Point of Sale locations, subject to operational availability.
What are the available payment methods for FASTag recharge at ICICI Bank?
Payment methods may include Net Banking, UPI, debit card, credit card or other approved digital channels.
How to recharge FASTag by chassis number online?
Log in to the FASTag portal, enter chassis number as per registration details, select recharge amount and complete the transaction.
Is there any charge for monthly toll pass recharge?
Monthly pass recharge is subject to toll operator policies and applicable charges.

FASTag FAQs
What is FASTag?
FASTag is a device that employs Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology for making toll payments directly from the Prepaid Account linked to it. It is affixed on the windscreen of your vehicle and enables you to drive through toll plazas, without stopping for cash transactions.
How to purchase FASTag?
Click here to purchase FASTag online and fill in your details. Your RFID tag will be delivered for free at your doorstep.
You can also log in to ICICI Bank Internet Banking/iMobile/InstaBIZ/Pockets app with your credentials to apply for FASTag.
How to recharge FASTag?
You may recharge your FASTag Account by making payment through cheque or online through Credit Card/Debit Card/NEFT/RTGS/UPI or Internet Banking.
For customers whose KYC documents are received, the FASTag Account recharge limit is Rs 1,00,000. For non-KYC customers, the recharge limit is Rs 10,000 only.
Click here to know more.

FASTag FAQs
What is FASTag?
FASTag is a device that employs Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology for making toll payments directly from the Prepaid Account linked to it. It is affixed on the windscreen of your vehicle and enables you to drive through toll plazas, without stopping for cash transactions.
How to purchase FASTag?
Click here to purchase FASTag online and fill in your details. Your RFID tag will be delivered for free at your doorstep.
You can also log in to ICICI Bank Net Banking/ICICI Bank’s iMobile app/ICICI Bank InstaBIZ app/Pockets by ICICI Bank with your credentials to apply for FASTag.
How to recharge FASTag?
You may recharge your FASTag Account by making payment through cheque or online through Credit Card/Debit Card/NEFT/RTGS/UPI or Net Banking.
For customers whose KYC documents are received, the FASTag Account recharge limit is ₹1,00,000. For non-KYC customers, the recharge limit is ₹10,000 only.
Click here to know more.
What is FASTag Customer Care number?
To know more about FASTag, please call our Customer Care on toll free number: 1800 2100 104 (chargeable number:1860 2670 104)
Can I buy a FASTag offline at an ICICI Bank branch or toll plaza?
Yes. FASTag can be purchased offline at authorised toll plaza Point of Sale locations. Customers must provide required KYC documents and vehicle details for issuance.
How do I find the nearest active FASTag toll plaza?
You can locate FASTag-enabled toll plazas through official National Electronic Toll Collection resources or by checking the updated toll plaza list available on ICICI Bank’s FASTag pages.
How long does it take to activate a FASTag bought offline?
Activation timelines depend on document verification and system processing. In many cases, FASTag purchased at authorised POS locations is activated shortly after successful registration and KYC validation.
How can I check my FASTag balance by a missed call?
Customers may check FASTag balance through SMS alerts, mobile banking, Net Banking or authorised missed call services, where available, linked to the registered mobile number.
What documents are required for FASTag purchase at POS?
To purchase FASTag at a POS location, customers typically need identity proof, address proof, vehicle Registration Certificate and vehicle details, subject to applicable KYC guidelines.

FASTag FAQs
What to do if I have raised request for closure of my FASTag, but my FASTag is still showing as active in NPCI and IHMCL records.
If your closure request is approved, your FASTag will be first put in 03 exception code (low balance status) in NPCI and IHMCL records. After 15 days of approval of request, you will receive refund of balance in your wallet and your FASTag will then be added to 06 exception code (closed status) in NPCI and IHMCL records.
I have raised request for closure for my FASTag, but it is not approved and my tag is still active. How can I get my tag closed.
Your closure request will be verified by the Bank basis the documents submitted. The TAT for verification is 3 business days. After the request is approved, your tag will be added to 03 exception code (low balance status) to block tag from doing transactions. After 15 days of approval of request, you will receive refund of balance in your wallet and your FASTag will then be added to 06 exception code (closed status) in NPCI and IHMCL records. If any transactions are sent by toll plaza on blocked tag, you can raise a dispute on the transactions for getting refund from the toll plaza. Once toll plaza accepts the dispute, you will receive the refund.
I have raised request for closure of my FASTag, but it is rejected. How can I check the reason for rejection.
You can login to FASTag web portal - https://fastaglogin.icicibank.com/CUSTLOGIN/Default.aspx and check the activity history of the vehicle for which closure request was raised. The activity history will display the reason for rejection. You can raise request for closure again with valid documents. In case of urgent permanent blocking of tag (if you have sold the vehicle), you can click on “View tag account summary” and then click on “Manage Tags” under “Vehicles” Tab, click on “Manage” and mark the tag as Lost/Stolen to add the tag to 06 exception code (closed/permanent block).
What to do if my FASTag sticker is disabled and I am not able to activate.
If your FASTag is hotlisted due to negative balance, you can recharge with sufficient balance and activate. If your FASTag sticker is hotlisted because of incorrect vehicle number or not updating registration certificate, or any other reason, please upload your registration certificate and reach out to customer care number - 1800 2100 104. If your FASTag is showing as “Closed” in NPCI and IHMCL records, it cannot be activated again. You can take a new FASTag under your existing FASTag wallet if the status of your FASTag in ICICI FASTag portal - https://fastaglogin.icicibank.com/CUSTLOGIN/Default.aspx is “Returndamage” or “LOST” or “STOLEN”. However, if your FASTag status is “HEXTAGCLOSED” or “CLOSED” or “PENDING CLOSED” or “REFUND REQUESTED” or “SUSPENDED” or “WRITE OFF”, you need to create new FASTag account for new FASTag. Existing account can be closed by following the process for FASTag wallet closure.
I have not used my FASTag for a period of 1 year and my FASTag is disabled. How can I activate my FASTag.
If your FASTag is showing as “Closed” in NPCI and IHMCl records, it cannot be activated again. You can check your FASTag wallet status in ICICI Bank FASTag web portal - https://fastaglogin.icicibank.com/CUSTLOGIN/Default.aspx If your FASTag status is “HEXTAGCLOSED” or “CLOSED” or “PENDING CLOSED” or “REFUND REQUESTED” or “SUSPENDED” or “WRITE OFF”, you need to create new FASTag account for new FASTag. Existing account can be closed by following the process for FASTag wallet closure.
How to Apply ICICI Bank FASTag?
You can apply through ICICI Bank’s website, FASTag Customer Portal or authorised channels by submitting vehicle and KYC details.
Do I have to use a specific lane at a toll plaza for FASTag?
Yes. Use the designated FASTag lane at toll plazas to enable automatic electronic toll deduction.
How can I block my FASTag account in case my vehicle is lost?
Immediately log in to the FASTag Customer Portal or contact the toll-free number to block the FASTag.
Is FASTag accepted at all toll plazas in India?
FASTag is accepted at NETC-enabled toll plazas across India as per national electronic toll collection guidelines.

What is Know Your Vehicle (KYV) verification?
It is mandatory that all FASTags issued, are associated with clear images of the Vehicle and the Tag. Hence, you require to submit clear images of the following:
The front and side views of your Vehicle
(i) While taking the image from the front, the Licence Plate Number and the FASTag sticker affixed to the Vehicle should be clearly visible, along with the edges of the Vehicle
(ii) While taking the image from the side, edges of the Vehicle both from the front side as well as the back side should be clearly visible
FASTag sticker affixed on the windshield of your Vehicle
Take the image of the sticker from inside the Vehicle after affixing the FASTag on the windshield. The Tag Serial Number on the sticker should be clearly visible
Registration Certificate (RC)
Upload the front and back images of the RC in the fields ‘RC Copy Front’ and ‘RC Copy Back’. You may choose to upload Digital RC copies obtained from DigiLocker or mParivahan apps.
To know more on KYV,  click here
Why is the KYV verification important?
As per regulations, it is mandatory to complete KYV verification. You need to ensure that all images uploaded are clear and correct. The KYV images will be verified by the Bank and if any application is declined based on the Bank’s sole discretion, your FASTag will be hotlisted (you will not be able to use your FASTag at toll plazas and you must pay the penalty imposed by regulatory authorities). To remove the FASTag from the hotlist, you need to upload the correct documents again (through the steps given below). Only once verified and approved, your FASTag will be removed from the hotlist.
FASTag FAQs
What is FASTag?
FASTag is an easy-to-use, reloadable tag that is affixed to your vehicle's windscreen. It enables automatic deduction of toll charges, so you can pass through toll plazas without stopping to pay toll manually. FASTag is linked to a prepaid account from which the applicable toll amounts are deducted.
The tag makes use of Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) technology to ensure that the relevant charges are automatically deducted from your prepaid account.
How can I recharge my FASTag online?
You can recharge your FASTag account by making a payment through cheque or online through Internet Banking or iMobile.
For customers whose KYC is complete, the FASTag account recharge limit is ₹ 1,00,000. For customers whose KYC documents have not been received, the recharge limit is ₹ 10,000.

Multi Wallet Prepaid Card FAQs
What is the ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
The ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card is a magnetic strip-based reloadable Prepaid Card, which is loaded in Indian Rupees. You can use this card to shop at merchant establishments that accept Credit and Debit Cards.
Where can I use my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
The ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card can be used at any merchant establishment (shop, department store, movie theatre, restaurant etc.) that accepts VISA Credit or Debit Cards. However, the usage of the Card depends upon the wallet configuration as directed by your company.
How soon after getting my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card can I start using it?
Your Card is activated once KYC is completed. It is loaded with funds for use once ICICI Bank receives the funds for the Card from your company.
How long is my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card valid for?
The validity of the Card is 5 years from the date of issue on the Card.
What about the available balance on the Card after the Card has expired?
You can place a request at our Customer Care for a replacement Card. The available balance will be transferred to the new Card when it is issued. Replacement charges of ₹200 + GST will be levied for the new Card.
Are there any charges for the usage of my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
There is no charge levied on the Card for spends at any merchant establishment or for checking the Card balance at any ICICI Bank ATM. However, balance enquiry done at any other bank’s ATM shall attract charges. For detailed charges, please visit the ‘Fees and Charges’ tab under the ‘Prepaid Card’ section on our website www.icicibank.com .
Can I add funds to my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
No. Funds can be added to your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card only by your company by way of your salary and reimbursements. There is no restriction on the number of times a Card can be reloaded.
Where can I check the balance on my Card?
You can check the balance on your Card using any of the below methods:
Send the following SMS to 5676766 / 9215676766:  PCBAL<Space>Last 4 digits of the Card
Call our Customer Care on 1800 1080
Check at any VISA-enabled ATM in India
Check using the ICICI Bank InstaBIZ app.
Where can I get details of the last transaction that I have made using my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
You can get the last 10 transactions made on your Card by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080. Alternatively, you can also log into the Self Care Portal with your User ID and Password for getting the details.
Do I need to maintain a minimum balance on my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card?
There is no need to maintain a minimum balance on your Card. However, keeping a healthy balance on your Card will help you in times of emergency.
Can I use an ATM to check the amount remaining on my Card?
Most ATMs have the facility to check the balance on your Card. However, cash withdrawal is not permitted.
What if I forget the ATM PIN of my Card?
If you forget your PIN, you can generate a new PIN using any of the below methods:
Call our Customer Care on 1800 1080
Log into the Prepaid Card Self Care Portal at this link: https://inrprepaid.icicibank.com/customer/login.jsp
Send the following SMS to 5676766: PCPIN<Space>Last 4 digits of Card
Is the ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card a secured Card?
Absolutely. To ensure maximum security, sign inside the signature panel present on the reverse of your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card as soon as you get it. Every time you use your Card, you need to sign on the charge slip (produced by the Electronic Data Capture machine at the time of purchase) to complete the transaction at the merchant establishment. The merchant shall match this signature with the signature present on the back on your Card, thus ensuring protection against unauthorised usage of your Card.
What happens if my ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card gets lost or stolen?
If your ICICI Bank Multi Wallet Prepaid Card is lost or stolen, report it to our Customer Care on 1800 1080 immediately, so that your Card can be blocked to prevent any misuse. We will then provide you with a replacement Card through your company.

Make purchases at stores or online
Withdraw cash at ATMs
Pay bills and manage their expenses conveniently.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

What is a Credit Card?

However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?

What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

It includes up to 50 days of interest-free credit, direct savings via a cash rebate programme, improved spending visibility for tracking and compliance and automated electronic uploads into your Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.
In what ways does the Corporate Credit Card India assist in employee cost control?
It gives companies tools for improved tracking and compliance, helping them monitor and manage employee T&E costs.
Is there a fuel surcharge applicable with the Corporate Credit Card?
Yes, the card offers a 1% of the transaction amount or ₹10 fuel cost waiver. Whichever is higher.
Are there any Corporate Credit Card joining or membership fees?
When you apply for a corporate credit card, a joining fee is not applicable for either the platinum or gold variant. However, an annual fee of ₹999 + GST is applicable for the platinum card's annual membership.
Can our ERP system be connected with the Corporate Credit Card?
Yes, the card offers electronic uploads and automation into your Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system, so it helps with smooth spending control.
How is the cash rebates programme set up?
The cash rebate programme directly saves money for your company through refunds on qualified transactions made with the Corporate Credit Card.
Where can I apply for the Corporate Credit Card from ICICI Bank?
You can apply for the Corporate Credit Card through the official ICICI Bank website or ask your Relationship Manager for help.
What are the fees and charges for ICICI Bank Corporate Credit Cards?
Fees vary by Corporate Credit Card type and usage. Refer to the Fees and Charges page for detailed information on applicable fees and other charges.
Who is eligible for an ICICI Bank Corporate Credit Card?
Corporate Credit Cards are issued to authorised employees of eligible organisations, subject to company approval and internal assessment by ICICI Bank.

Forex Cards FAQ’s
What is an ICICI Bank Forex Prepaid Card?
It is a Prepaid Card that offers 15 currency wallets, serving as a secure alternative for carrying foreign currency while traveling.
What is a Forex Prepaid Card used for?
It is a convenient payment option during international travel, allowing easy payments without cash.
What are the benefits of having a Forex Prepaid/Travel Card?
Store multiple currencies on a single Card
No extra charges for e-commerce transactions and transactions at merchant outlets
Universally accepted
Fixed exchange rates at the time of loading, avoiding dynamic currency conversion fees.
What is a Multi-Currency Card?
A multi-currency Card has multiple wallets for different currencies loaded on it. ICICI Bank allows you to load up to 15 currencies on one Card.
Can I transfer money from my Forex Prepaid Card to my Bank Account?
Yes, the remaining amount can be refunded to the linked Bank Account when no longer needed.
How can I get a Forex Prepaid Card near me?
Submit your request at your nearest ICICI Bank Forex Branch or through the iMobile app if you have an ICICI Bank Savings Account.
How do I load money on my Forex Prepaid Card?
You can load funds online through Internet Banking or the iMobile app. Alternatively, you can visit an ICICI Bank Forex Branch to load funds.
How can I activate my Forex Prepaid Card?
The Card activates automatically when you load it with funds. For inactive Cards, contact Customer Care for reactivation.
What should I do if I cannot withdraw funds from an ATM using my Forex Prepaid Card?
Check your card balance
Ensure you are within your daily withdrawal limit
If the issue persists, contact Customer Care for assistance.
What is the limit for cash withdrawals from ATMs using Forex Prepaid Card?
The daily withdrawal limit is $ 2,000 or its equivalent in any other currency, including charges and taxes.
Can I retain the foreign exchange on my ICICI Bank Forex Prepaid Card after returning to India?
Yes, but only if the remaining balance is less than $ 2,000. Refunds must be claimed within 180 days of return, as per RBI regulations.

Know about DCC (Dynamic Currency Conversion)
There may be costs/charges associated with currency conversion levied by the third party on the Dynamic Currency Conversion (‘DCC’) transaction. DCC is permitted in all acceptance environments where the customer can make a currency choice for their payment e.g. Point of Sale (POS), online and ATM. Please apprise yourself and ascertain such costs/charges before providing confirmation for a DCC transaction. ICICI Bank declares that it does not derive any direct or indirect benefit (save and except for charges for currency conversion from billing currency to active wallet currency). As DCC transaction request is initiated by the customer post customer’s confirmation, ICICI Bank disclaims any liability for the refund of any DCC transaction related charges.

A personalised Card has the Cardholder’s name printed on it. Non-personalised Cards do not have names printed on them. The daily withdrawal limit is $2,000 or its equivalent in any other currency, inclusive of charges and taxes.
Can I retain the foreign exchange on my ICICI Bank Forex Prepaid Card after returning to India?
Yes, but only if the remaining balance is less than $2,000. Refunds must be claimed within 180 days of return, as per RBI regulations.
What is the cost of a Forex Prepaid Card?

Can a Forex Prepaid Card be used to withdraw cash?

Can I get a Forex Prepaid Card in one day?

Can money be transferred from a Forex Prepaid Card to a bank account?
Yes, the unused balance can be easily refunded to your linked bank account once you no longer need the Forex Prepaid Card. You just have to place a request with the Bank.

Forex Prepaid Cards (also known as Travel Cards or Forex Cards) are widely accepted at international stores, hotels, online platforms and ATMs wherever the network (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) is supported.
What is the Forex limit in India?
Under RBI’s Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), Indians can spend or remit up to USD <2,50,000> per financial year for travel, studies, medical treatment or other permitted uses. This limit also applies to Forex Prepaid Cards.
Can a Forex Prepaid Card be used at the airport?
Yes, you can use a Forex Prepaid Card at international airports for food, shopping or services, wherever Card payments are accepted.
