What is ICICI Bank Instant EMI?
ICICI Bank Instant EMI allows you to convert eligible Credit Card purchases into easy monthly instalments. You can shop in full and repay in parts, choosing from flexible tenure options ranging from 3 to 24 months.
What is the minimum and maximum transaction amount eligible for Instant EMI?
You can convert transactions starting from as low as ₹1,500 up to ₹10 lakh into Instant EMI, provided your ICICI Bank Credit Card has sufficient available credit at the time of the request.
Is any documentation required to avail Instant EMI?
No additional paperwork is needed! Instant EMI conversion is completely hassle-free and paperless. Just request EMI at the time of transaction, and if your card account has a sufficient credit limit, it will be approved instantly.
What are the tenure and interest rate options under Instant EMI?
ICICI Bank offers flexible tenures of 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, or 24 months. An interest rate of 15.99% p.a. is applicable across these tenures. For selected merchants, No Extra Cost EMI options are also available — the extra cost is borne by the merchant or brand, not by ICICI Bank.
How can I check and track my Instant EMI transactions?
Once your transaction is converted into Instant EMI, the details will appear clearly in your monthly Credit Card statement. You can also use the EMI Calculator on the ICICI Bank website to view and plan your repayment schedule.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?
The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.
Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card?
To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.
How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?
You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.
How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?
To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:
1. Select the movie you want to watch
2. Click on ‘Book tickets’
3. Select the location and venue
4. Select the number of seats and proceed
5. Click on ‘Pay’
6. Accept the T&Cs
7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button
8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option
9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)
10. Enter the entire Credit Card number
11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message.
What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?
You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.
What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.
Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?
You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.
Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?
The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.
How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.
Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?
ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver.
Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?
Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.
Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?
Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.
Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?
Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icici.bank.in
How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?
Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.
What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Chip Credit Cards come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.
Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?
All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.
How to generate my Plus (Add-On) Card PIN?
Pin can be generated through iMobile (Only by Primary Cardholder):
Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.
Customer Care:
(To be done by Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder, if Plus (Add-On) Card Cardholder phone number is updated):
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.
How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:
Visit the BookMyShow website
Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets
Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”
Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”
Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction
How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?
The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.
Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).
Tips for secure Credit Card usage

In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.
Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts
Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.
Do's
Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges
Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities
Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.
Don’ts
Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone
Don't exceed your credit limit
Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Platinum Chip Credit Card FAQs
Is there a joining fee or annual fee for Platinum Chip Credit Card?
The Platinum Chip Credit Card has no joining fee or annual fee.
What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it on my ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card?
Flip your Platinum Chip Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.
Which bank’s Credit Card should I opt for?
The ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card is an excellent choice. It has no joining fee or annual fee.
What is the age limit to apply for a Platinum Chip Credit Card?
You must be between the ages of 21-65 years to be eligible to apply for an ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card.
How to know the payment due date of the Platinum Chip Credit Card?
You can know the payment due date of your Platinum Chip Credit Card through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.
Which Bank issues a Credit Card at no cost?
ICICI Bank issues the Platinum Chip Credit Card without any joining fee and annual fee. For more information, call on 1800 1080.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please  click here .
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000 at HPCL fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
How do the chip and PIN improve security?
The chip and PIN provide robust protection against Card misuse by requiring a PIN for in-person transactions. This prevents unauthorized access even if the card is lost or stolen, significantly reducing the risk of fraudulent use.
When is the PIN required for transactions?
The PIN is required for transactions made on POS terminals (swipe machines) at merchant outlets in physical locations. Customers must enter their PIN on the terminal to complete the transaction securely.
Is PIN required for online transactions?
No, the PIN is not required for online transactions. Online payments can be completed without entering the PIN, but other security measures may still apply, such as OTP verification.

Rubyx Debit Card FAQs
How are reward points calculated on the Rubyx Debit Card?
On every ₹200 spent on the Rubyx Debit Card, Cardholders earn 3 reward points on domestic transactions and 6 reward points on international transactions. Please note that some spend categories do not earn reward points.
What are the daily withdrawal limits of the Rubyx Debit Card?
The Rubyx Debit Card has high daily withdrawal limits. You can withdraw up to ₹1,50,000 at both domestic and international ATMs. The monthly limit is capped as per the customer segment.
Please give details of the Rubyx Debit Card lounge access benefit.
With the Rubyx Debit Card, Cardholders can avail airport lounge access for a maximum of 2 times in a quarter if they have made transactions worth ₹10,000 on the Card in the previous calendar quarter.
Can I use my Rubyx Debit Card for online international transactions?
Yes, the Rubyx Debit Card can be used for online international transactions. It’s equipped with the necessary security features like 3D Secure (3DS) to ensure safe and secure payments. Make sure international transactions are enabled on your Card by contacting Customer Care or through iMobile or Net Banking.
What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?
To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹10,000 or more on your Rubyx Debit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.
Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria,  click here . To view the complete list of lounges,  click here .
Can I get discounts on movie tickets through the Rubyx Debit Card?

Credit Card Against Fixed Deposit FAQs
What is a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
A fixed deposit credit card, also known as a credit card against fixed deposit, is a unique product that gives you a complimentary instant Credit Card against your Fixed Deposit. This Credit Card offers twin benefits: liquidity and safety.
How can I apply for an Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
Applying for an ICICI Bank Fixed Deposit Credit Card is very simple and convenient. Just use any of the following methods:
Visit a branch:
If you prefer face-to-face assistance, simply visit any ICICI Bank branch. Our team there will guide you through the application process, ensuring that you have all the necessary documents and information
Apply Online:
If you prefer the convenience of online banking, simply log into your ICICI Bank Net Banking account or the ICICI Bank's iMobile app, navigate to the Fixed Deposits section, click on ‘Open Fixed Deposit Card’ and follow the steps to complete your application.
What are the benefits of using a Credit Card against Fixed Deposit?
Using a Credit Card against Fixed Deposit provides immediate access to funds while ensuring that your savings remain secure. This allows you to enjoy liquidity without compromising your capital. In addition, it helps you build or improve your credit history, making it easier for you to take larger loans or get a larger credit limit in future.
What is the minimum Fixed Deposit amount required to get an Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
You have to open a Fixed Deposit of minimum ₹50,000 to get a Fixed Deposit Credit Card. This ensures that you have sufficient funds as collateral against which a Credit Card can be issued.
Can I use my Fixed Deposit to get a Credit Card?
Yes, you can use your Fixed Deposit to get a Credit Card. The Fixed Deposit serves as collateral, allowing you to get a credit limit of up to 90% of your Fixed Deposit amount.
What are the eligibility criteria for an Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
To be eligible for a Fixed Deposit Credit Card, your Fixed Deposit amount must be ₹50,000 or more and it should be opened in auto-renewal mode.
What interest rate is offered on the Fixed Deposit in a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
The interest rate offered on the Fixed Deposit in an Fixed Deposit Credit Card is the same as that offered on standard Fixed Deposits. This means your investment continues to earn interest while also being used as collateral for your Credit Card.
What are the benefits of a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
There are multiple benefits of an Fixed Deposit Credit Card like instant approval, low interest rates on Credit Card repayments, improvement of your credit score and minimal documentation.
What happens if I need to close my Fixed Deposit while having a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?
If you need to close your Fixed Deposit, you will have to first pay any outstanding dues on your Fixed Deposit Credit Card. After clearing the dues, you can close your Fixed Deposit.

Rubyx Credit Card FAQs
Is there a joining fee and Annual fee for the Rubyx Credit Card?
Yes. The Rubyx Credit Card has a joining fee of ₹3,000 + GST and annual fee of ₹2,000 + GST.
When will I get my Joining Benefits for the Rubyx Credit Card?
You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the Joining Fee.
What is included in the joining benefit vouchers?
Upon payment of the joining fee, Credit Cardholders will receive welcome vouchers worth over ₹5,000 on their registered e-mail ID within 45 days. There are vouchers worth ₹2,000 from Tata CLiQ, ₹2,000 from EaseMyTrip (2 vouchers of ₹1,000 each for domestic flight bookings), ₹1,000 from Croma (2 vouchers of ₹500 each), ₹3,000 from EaseMyTrip for holiday packages and ₹10,000 from Elivaas. You also get a 3-month EazyDiner Prime Membership worth ₹1,095 and up to 35% discount at Avis for car rentals.
To know more about redemption of vouchers, click here
For other Terms and Conditions,  click here

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?
To enjoy domestic airport lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Rubyx Credit Card in a preceding spend quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.
For the customers with dual Credit Card variants(Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) , the entitlement includes 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter for each variant.
Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria,  click here . To view the complete list of lounges,  click here .

This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period.

What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?
As a Rubyx Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail of a maximum of 2 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit https://teetimes.truztee. com / and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.
To view the updated list of golf courses, please  click here . For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please  click here . You may also call iAssist, the 24/7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.
How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?
Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:
Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform https://teetimes. truztee .com/ with your registered mobile number.
Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.
Submit your booking request and await confirmation.
Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.
You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.
What are the key features of the concierge services offered?
The concierge services provide 24X7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower & gift deliveries, hotel & flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).
What are the criteria for availing domestic railway lounge access?
Enjoy complimentary access to railway lounge with your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card. Get 2 complimentary access to the selected railway lounges in India every quarter. Simply present your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card to enjoy the lounge benefits
Any additional access beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider The access to railway lounges will be applicable only for primary cardholders.
Click here for a complete list of lounges.
What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?
Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please click here
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transaction from ₹400 - ₹4000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?
The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹1 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards, please  click here .
Do I get reward points on Fuel transactions?
No, you do not get reward points on Fuel transactions. 1% fuel surcharge waiver is applicable on all fuel transactions from ₹400 - ₹4000 at any fuel outlet in India.
How can I get the annual fee waived off for the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?
If you spend over ₹3 lakh, you can get your annual fee waived off for the next year.
Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?
Yes. You can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card.
What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it in my ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?
Flip your Rubyx Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
Which Credit Card should I opt for to get benefits on shopping?
ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card is one of the best choices. It offers several benefits for shopping enthusiasts.
What is the age limit to apply for a Rubyx Credit Card?
You must be between the age of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the Rubyx Credit Card.
How do I know the payment due date of my ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?
You can know the payment due date of your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card through the monthly statement, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.

You must be between the age of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the RuPay Credit Card.
How do I know the payment due date of the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
You can find the payment due date of your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card either through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling Customer Care on 1800 1080.
How do I link the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile App for UPI payments?
Please follow the steps below to link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile App:
Step 1: Download and log into the iMobile app
Step 2: Select ‘UPI Payments’
Step 3: Click on ‘UPI Settings
Step 4: Select ‘RuPay Credit Card’
Step 5: Click on ‘Enter Last 6 digits of Credit Card’ and enter the corresponding digits of the Credit Card Number
Step 6: Enter your 4-digit PIN
Step 7: Click on ‘Confirm’.
Will I need a separate UPI PIN for my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for payments?
Yes, the UPI PIN requirement may differ depending on the platform used for linking your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card.
On ICICI Bank iMobile App (Non-Logged In): No separate UPI PIN is required. Your MPIN will be used for authentication.
On ICICI Bank iMobile App (Logged In): Device binding and login credentials act as two-factor authentication, so a separate UPI PIN is not needed.
On Third-Party UPI Apps (TPAPs): A separate UPI PIN needs to be created while linking your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments.
What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on iMobile App?
The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card can be linked on the iMobile App post 1 hour of the RuPay Credit Card creation. For non-QR code UPI transactions (e.g. online payments), online transactions must be enabled for your Credit Card. QR code-based iMobile App UPI transactions can be initiated after the RuPay Credit Card is successfully linked to UPI.
How can I pay a merchant using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on UPI?
You can make payments using the iMobile app by following the path below: Open iMobile App > Scan any QR > Select ‘Pay with RuPay Credit Card > Enter UPI PIN > Confirm
Payments can also be made using your UPI ID payments by entering your UPI OD at merchant apps/ websites and then approving the request on iMobile App at the path below: Log into iMobile App > UPI Payments > Payment Requests > Accept.
Do I need to have the same mobile number linked to my UPI app as well as my RuPay Credit Card?
Yes, the mobile number used on UPI apps should be same as the mobile number linked to your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. If you have changed your mobile number, please update the same for your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card as well. After updating, you will need to re-register the Credit Card on the UPI app.
What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with third-party UPI payment apps, i.e. UPI apps other than iMobile App?
ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card expiry details need to be entered for the Card to be linked to third-party UPI apps.
Can I make a UPI payment to any person or other Credit Card using my linked ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
No, only Person to Merchant (P2M) (e.g. payments at stores, websites etc.) are allowed from the linked Credit Card. Other types of payments are not allowed.
Can I link my Visa/ MasterCard/ Diners Credit Card on UPI?
Currently, as per RBI guidelines, only RuPay Credit Cards can be linked on UPI.
What are the limits on transactions allowed from a linked Credit Card on UPI?
There is no limit for the number of transactions carried out from a linked Credit Card on UPI. However, the limit on the transaction amount allowed from linked Credit Cards on UPI is governed by the UPI transaction limits set by the National Payments corporation of India (NPCI) and the Credit Limit provided to you on your Credit Card (whichever is lower).
What are the restricted merchant categories on which customers are not allowed to make UPI payments, using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Cards cannot be used for certain restricted merchant categories for payments through UPI. These may include person-to-person transfers (P2P), P2PM transactions, cash withdrawals, lending platforms, IPO applications, mutual fund investments, foreign inward remittances and other categories restricted by ICICI Bank from time to time. Users are advised to check the latest guidelines and applicable terms before making transactions.
Can I make my linked Credit Card as a default account to receive funds?
No, funds cannot be received on a linked Credit Card through UPI.
Do I need to enable Card controls on the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for online transactions?
Yes, you need to enable online transactions on your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card using iMobile App/ Net Banking to use Credit Cards for regular online purchases as well as online UPI transactions.
If my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed, do I need to link it again to UPI?
Yes, in case the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed or replaced, you have to re-register the Credit Card in the UPI apps you use.
Where can I see the UPI transactions on my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Credit Card transactions through UPI will be available in your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card statement every month. The statement can be checked on iMobile App at Credit Cards > View Statement and on Net Banking at Cards > Credit Cards > Statement.
Will I earn any reward points for UPI spends using ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
Yes, UPI spends using Credit Card will earn reward points as per the reward point structure of the respective Credit Card.
Will I get any surcharge waiver on fuel purchases made using RuPay Credit Card via UPI mode?
Fuel surcharge waiver will be applicable as per the respective Credit Card features. For more details about UPI transactions using the RuPay Credit Card, click here .
How do I see my Credit Card Number online?
To view your ICICI Bank Credit Card Number online, log into iMobile App or Net Banking and view your Credit Card details.
How do I link my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI to make payments?

Select 'RuPay Credit Card'

Can a RuPay Credit Card be used internationally?
International usage depends on the RuPay Credit Card variant and the merchant acceptance network available in the destination country. Certain ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Cards may support international transactions and online payments where RuPay acceptance is enabled. Customers can also manage international usage settings through Net Banking or iMobile app.
Are there any mandatory requirements prior to linking ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on UPI App?
Before linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on a supported UPI app, ensure that the mobile number registered with the Bank is active on the device. Customers should also complete the required OTP verification and create a UPI PIN for transaction authentication. The app should support RuPay Credit Card integration for merchant payments.

It offers convenience for online, offline and QR code transactions along with features and benefits such as reward points, secure digital payments and merchant linked benefits.
What is the difference between a RuPay Credit Card and a regular Credit Card?

The core features such as billing cycle, repayment process, interest charges and credit limit remain similar, while UPI integration adds additional payment convenience.
Are there any charges associated with RuPay Credit Cards?

Who can issue a RuPay Credit Card?

Emirates Skywards Credit Card FAQs
What are the kinds of Emirates Skywards credit cards available in India?
The types of Emirates Skywards Credit Cards in India are
Emirates Emeralde: Best for High- End Flying Perks
Emirates Sapphiro: Luxury Travel and Lifestyle
Emirates Rubyx: Best for Frequent Flyers
How do I accumulate Skywards Miles on these credit cards?
You get 2.5 Miles, 2 miles and 1.5 miles for ₹100 spent using your Emaralde, Sapphiro and Rubyx credit cards. Miles are awarded for expenditure on travel, lifestyle, and daily spends.
Is airport lounge access available on these cards?
Yes, lounge access is card-specific. The Emarlade card entitles users to unrestricted access to domestic and international airport lounges. Sapphiro offers two free domestic lounge visits every quarter and two free foreign lounge visits annually, whereas Rubyx offers one free domestic lounge visit every three months.
What should I do if I notice an unauthorised transaction on my credit card?
If you detect any unauthorised transaction, immediately contact ICICI Bank Customer Care or Internet Banking to report it.
How do I get an Emirates Skywards Credit Card?
You can apply online from the ICICI Bank website or any ICICI Bank branch. Check if you meet the eligibility criteria and have the documents necessary for a smooth application.
Can I apply for an Plus (Add-On) Card for my family members?
Yes, you can apply for up to three Plus (Add-On) Card for your immediate family members (spouse, parents, siblings, Mother in Law, Father in Law, Son in Law, Daughter in Law or children 12 years and above).
How do I redeem my Skywards Miles accrued through the credit card?
The Skywards Miles are credited to your Emirates Skywards account. You can redeem them for Emirates flights, upgrades, hotel stays, and other partner services.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Yes. The Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card is a luxury Credit Card from ICICI Bank. It is packed with plenty of premium benefits.
What is the best metal Credit Card currently available with ICICI bank?
If you are looking for the best metal Credit Card, then the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card is an excellent choice for you. It has top luxury lifestyle offers & benefits.
Is there a joining fee and Annual fee for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Yes. The Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card has a joining fee and Annual fee of ₹12,499 + GST.
How can Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cardholders claim their joining vouchers?
Step 1: Log into ICICI Bank Rewards
•  iMobile App:
Open iMobile 🡪 Cards & Forex 🡪 Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit
•  Internet Banking:
Log in 🡪 Cards 🡪 Credit cards 🡪 Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit
Step 2: On the Rewards site, click the ‘Joining Benefit / Annual Benefit’ tab to open the Benefits Page.
Step 3: Find details for your TAJ Epicure and EazyDiner vouchers.
Your Voucher Code and / or PIN and steps to redeem are displayed next to each voucher
Follow the on-screen instructions for membership activation and voucher redemption.
For details and T&Cs, click here
When will I get the Joining Benefits for my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the Joining Fee.
How to avail complimentary international airport lounge access?
Enjoy unlimited complimentary access to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.
Priority Pass Membership
Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for both the primary cardholder and Plus cardholder with ICICI Bank Emeralde Metal Credit Card
Access 1,800+ lounges in 146 countries worldwide
Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.
For complete list of international airport lounges visit https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges
What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?
For lounge visits within India, Primary and Add-on Cardholders can avail unlimited complimentary lounge access through ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. Please swipe the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card to avail the complimentary lounge access. To view the complete list of lounges, click here .
What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?
As an Emeralde Private Metal, Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for unlimited round or lesson of golf. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit https://teetimes.truztee.com/   and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.
To view the updated list of golf courses, please click here . For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please click here . You may also call iAssist, the 24x7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.
How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?
Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:
Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform https://teetimes.truztee.com/ with your registered mobile number.
Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.
Submit your booking request and await confirmation.
Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.
You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.
What are the movie ticket benefits available Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Cardholders are eligible for a Buy-One-Get-One movies, sport events, theatre or concert tickets offer worth up to ₹750 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please click here .
What are the key features of the concierge services offered?
The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).
What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?
The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards.
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?
Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please click here .
What is the age limit for the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
You must be between the age group of 21–65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.
How can I know the bill due date of my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can find the bill due date of your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card on your monthly statement, in the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care at 1800 1080.
Is it safe to transact with the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Yes. Since your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip for high-level security, you can transact safely & securely.
What are the key features of the Mastercard Privileges?
Mastercard Moments is an exclusive programme specially created for Mastercard cardholders. At the heart of this programme is a host of exceptional experiences designed to inspire and enrich the lives of our Mastercard cardholders, with programme members able to enjoy additional benefits.
For more details,  https://specials.priceless.com/en-in/homePage
How do I find the CVV on my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Flip your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your Card Verification Value (CVV). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card FAQs
Is the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card a luxury Credit Card?
Yes. The Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card is a luxury Credit Card from ICICI Bank. It is packed with plenty of premium benefits.
What is the best metal Credit Card currently available with ICICI bank?
If you are looking for the best metal Credit Card, then the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card is an excellent choice for you. It has top luxury lifestyle offers & benefits.
Is there a joining fee and Annual fee for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Yes. The Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card has a joining fee and Annual fee of ₹12,499 + GST.
How can Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cardholders claim their joining vouchers?
Step 1: Log into ICICI Bank Rewards
•  iMobile App:
Open iMobile 🡪 Cards & Forex 🡪 Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit
•  Internet Banking:
Log in 🡪 Cards 🡪 Credit cards 🡪 Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit
Step 2: On the Rewards site, click the ‘Joining Benefit / Annual Benefit’ tab to open the Benefits Page.
Step 3: Find details for your TAJ Epicure and EazyDiner vouchers.
Your Voucher Code and / or PIN and steps to redeem are displayed next to each voucher
Follow the on-screen instructions for membership activation and voucher redemption.
For details and T&Cs, click here
When will I get the Joining Benefits for my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the Joining Fee.
How to avail complimentary international airport lounge access?
Enjoy unlimited complimentary access to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.
Priority Pass Membership
Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for both the primary cardholder and Plus cardholder with ICICI Bank Emeralde Metal Credit Card
Access 1,800+ lounges in 146 countries worldwide
Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.
For complete list of international airport lounges visit https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges
What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?
For lounge visits within India, Primary and Add-on Cardholders can avail unlimited complimentary lounge access through ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. Please swipe the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card to avail the complimentary lounge access. To view the complete list of lounges, click here .
What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?
As an Emeralde Private Metal, Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for unlimited round or lesson of golf. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit https://teetimes.truztee.com/   and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.
To view the updated list of golf courses, please click here . For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please click here . You may also call iAssist, the 24x7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.
How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?
Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:
Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform https://teetimes.truztee.com/ with your registered mobile number.
Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.
Submit your booking request and await confirmation.
Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.
You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.
What are the movie ticket benefits available Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Cardholders are eligible for a Buy-One-Get-One movies, sport events, theatre or concert tickets offer worth up to ₹750 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please click here .
What are the key features of the concierge services offered?
The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).
What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?
The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards.
What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?
Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.
What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?
Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.
What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?
The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please click here .
What is the age limit for the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
You must be between the age group of 21–65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.
How can I know the bill due date of my ICICI Bank Credit Card?
You can find the bill due date of your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card on your monthly statement, in the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care at 1800 1080.
Is it safe to transact with the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Yes. Since your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip for high-level security, you can transact safely & securely.
What are the key features of the Mastercard Privileges?
Mastercard Moments is an exclusive programme specially created for Mastercard cardholders. At the heart of this programme is a host of exceptional experiences designed to inspire and enrich the lives of our Mastercard cardholders, with programme members able to enjoy additional benefits.
For more details,  https://specials.priceless.com/en-in/homePage
How do I find the CVV on my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?
Flip your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your Card Verification Value (CVV). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

EMI On Call FAQs
What is the ‘EMI On Call’ facility?
After making a purchase with your Credit Card, you can choose to pay for it in the form of EMIs (Equated Monthly Instalments) through ICICI Bank's iMobile app, WhatsApp Banking, Net Banking, the OTP page or using your phone. ICICI Bank’s EMI On Call facility helps you pay the instalments conveniently over a tenure that ranges from 3 months – 24 months.
What types of transactions can be converted to ‘EMI On Call’?
All retail transactions of ₹ 1,500 and above can be converted into EMIs, with some exceptions:
Transactions older than 30 days cannot be converted into EMIs
Certain categories of transactions like cash, gambling, fuel, gold and jewellery purchase, etc. are not eligible for the ‘EMI On Call’ facility. In particular, jewellery & gold transactions cannot be converted into EMIs as per the guidelines issued by RBI from time to time.
What are the charges applicable on availing the EMI On Call facility?
This facility offers EMI payments with interest payment at a rate of up to 1.5% per month on a monthly reducing balance basis. A one-time processing fee of up to 2% of the transaction value is charged at the time of EMI conversion. A foreclosure fee of up to 3% and advance EMI interest and GST as applicable shall be chargeable if you opt for pre-closure of the EMIs.
How can I pay the EMIs through ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Customers wondering how to pay EMI through Credit Card do not need to make a separate payment for EMIs. The EMI amount is included in the monthly ICICI Bank Credit Card statement and can be paid along with the total outstanding amount as per the billing cycle, subject to applicable terms and conditions.
What if I convert my Credit Card transaction into EMI after the statement is generated?
You can deduct the converted amount from the statement bill and pay the differential amount.
Will converting to EMI affect my credit score?
Converting to EMI does not negatively impact your credit score as long as you make timely EMI payments. However, late payments can affect your credit score.
Is No Cost EMI available on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, No Cost EMI may be available on select transactions, subject to merchant tie-ups and ICICI Bank terms and conditions.
Who is eligible for No Cost EMI on Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card?
All customers who hold an active Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card are eligible for No Cost EMI, subject to applicable merchant terms and transaction criteria.

Credit Card fees and interest rates
Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

What is a Credit Card?

The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.
The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.
Interest Charge
Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.
Late Payment Fee
If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.
Over-the-Limit Fee
You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.
GST
Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.
To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card
What is a Credit Card?
A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.
What is the limit of a Credit Card?
A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history.
What is Credit Card balance?
Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.
Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?
Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.
How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?
To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here .
What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?
The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.
How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?
Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card.
What is a RuPay Credit Card?
A RuPay Credit Card is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.
Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily apply for a Loan on your Credit Card if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

ICICI Bank Rupay Credit Card FAQs
Does the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card provide discounts on movie tickets?
Yes, the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card does provide discounts on movie tickets.
What is the benefit of using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card offers:
Reward points on UPI and card transactions
Seamless linking to UPI apps for easy payments
No-cost EMI on eligible purchases
Wide merchant acceptance across India via the RuPay network
Card management through the ICICI Bank iMobile app
Exclusive partner offers and discounts
Digital and contactless payment options
Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
Yes. You can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card.
What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it in my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
Flip your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. The 3-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.
What is the age limit to apply for a RuPay Credit Card?
You must be between the age of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the RuPay Credit Card.
How do I know the payment due date of the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
You can find the payment due date of your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card either through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling Customer Care on 1800 1080.
How do I link the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile App for UPI payments?
Please follow the steps below to link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile App:
Step 1: Download and log into the iMobile app
Step 2: Select ‘UPI Payments’
Step 3: Click on ‘UPI Settings
Step 4: Select ‘RuPay Credit Card’
Step 5: Click on ‘Enter Last 6 digits of Credit Card’ and enter the corresponding digits of the Credit Card Number
Step 6: Enter your 4-digit PIN
Step 7: Click on ‘Confirm’.
Will I need a separate UPI PIN for my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for payments?
Yes, the UPI PIN requirement may differ depending on the platform used for linking your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card.
On ICICI Bank iMobile App (Non-Logged In): No separate UPI PIN is required. Your MPIN will be used for authentication.
On ICICI Bank iMobile App (Logged In): Device binding and login credentials act as two-factor authentication, so a separate UPI PIN is not needed.
On Third-Party UPI Apps (TPAPs): A separate UPI PIN needs to be created while linking your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments.
What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on iMobile App?
The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card can be linked on the iMobile App post 1 hour of the RuPay Credit Card creation. For non-QR code UPI transactions (e.g. online payments), online transactions must be enabled for your Credit Card. QR code-based iMobile App UPI transactions can be initiated after the RuPay Credit Card is successfully linked to UPI.
How can I pay a merchant using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on UPI?
You can make payments using the iMobile app by following the path below: Open iMobile App > Scan any QR > Select ‘Pay with RuPay Credit Card > Enter UPI PIN > Confirm
Payments can also be made using your UPI ID payments by entering your UPI OD at merchant apps/ websites and then approving the request on iMobile App at the path below: Log into iMobile App > UPI Payments > Payment Requests > Accept.
Do I need to have the same mobile number linked to my UPI app as well as my RuPay Credit Card?
Yes, the mobile number used on UPI apps should be same as the mobile number linked to your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. If you have changed your mobile number, please update the same for your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card as well. After updating, you will need to re-register the Credit Card on the UPI app.
What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with third-party UPI payment apps, i.e. UPI apps other than iMobile App?
ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card expiry details need to be entered for the Card to be linked to third-party UPI apps.
Can I make a UPI payment to any person or other Credit Card using my linked ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
No, only Person to Merchant (P2M) (e.g. payments at stores, websites etc.) are allowed from the linked Credit Card. Other types of payments are not allowed.
Can I link my Visa/ MasterCard/ Diners Credit Card on UPI?
Currently, as per RBI guidelines, only RuPay Credit Cards can be linked on UPI.
What are the limits on transactions allowed from a linked Credit Card on UPI?
There is no limit for the number of transactions carried out from a linked Credit Card on UPI. However, the limit on the transaction amount allowed from linked Credit Cards on UPI is governed by the UPI transaction limits set by the National Payments corporation of India (NPCI) and the Credit Limit provided to you on your Credit Card (whichever is lower).
What are the restricted merchant categories on which customers are not allowed to make UPI payments, using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Cards cannot be used for certain restricted merchant categories for payments through UPI. These may include person-to-person transfers (P2P), P2PM transactions, cash withdrawals, lending platforms, IPO applications, mutual fund investments, foreign inward remittances and other categories restricted by ICICI Bank from time to time. Users are advised to check the latest guidelines and applicable terms before making transactions.
Can I make my linked Credit Card as a default account to receive funds?
No, funds cannot be received on a linked Credit Card through UPI.
Do I need to enable Card controls on the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for online transactions?
Yes, you need to enable online transactions on your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card using iMobile App/ Net Banking to use Credit Cards for regular online purchases as well as online UPI transactions.
If my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed, do I need to link it again to UPI?
Yes, in case the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed or replaced, you have to re-register the Credit Card in the UPI apps you use.
Where can I see the UPI transactions on my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
ICICI Bank Credit Card transactions through UPI will be available in your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card statement every month. The statement can be checked on iMobile App at Credit Cards > View Statement and on Net Banking at Cards > Credit Cards > Statement.
Will I earn any reward points for UPI spends using ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?
Yes, UPI spends using Credit Card will earn reward points as per the reward point structure of the respective Credit Card.
Will I get any surcharge waiver on fuel purchases made using RuPay Credit Card via UPI mode?
Fuel surcharge waiver will be applicable as per the respective Credit Card features. For more details about UPI transactions using the RuPay Credit Card, click here .
How do I see my Credit Card Number online?
To view your ICICI Bank Credit Card Number online, log into iMobile App or Net Banking and view your Credit Card details.
How do I link my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI to make payments?
You can link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI using the iMobile app. Please follow the steps below:
Log into iMobile App
Click on the 'UPI Payments' tab
Click on 'UPI Settings'
Click on the button at the bottom-right side of the screen
Select 'RuPay Credit Card'
Select the desired bank whose Credit Card you want to link
Verify the Card details, set the UPI PIN and you are ready to go!
You can now use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments at merchant outlets which support the same.
